WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, avg_stats.avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND (lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18' OR lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5') GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS avg_stats ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = avg_stats.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, COUNT(CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergraduate_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units, sc.undergraduate_subjects, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SubjectCounts AS sc ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE sc.undergraduate_subjects > 0.6 * sc.total_subjects
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS tip_department_name, lso.SUBJECT_ID AS library_subject_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.library_subject_id, inner_cte.library_subject_title, inner_cte.tip_department_name, dept_counts.total_subjects_per_department FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT tip.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT) AS total_subjects_per_department FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tip ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tip.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tip.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tip.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.tip_department_name = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT i.FIRST_NAME, i.LAST_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS num_historical_records, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, num_historical_records, total_assignable_area, (CAST(total_assignable_area * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(num_historical_records, 0)) AS avg_assignable_area_per_record FROM inner_cte WHERE total_assignable_area > (SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT department_name, department_full_name, COUNT(student_full_name) AS num_graduate_students, MAX(school_code_dense_rank) AS highest_school_code_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, department_full_name ORDER BY department_name NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students, tmax.TERM_CODE AS term_with_max_enrollment, tmax.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_students FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS tmax ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tmax.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tmax.TERM_CODE, tmax.max_enrolled_students
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > ds.avg_total_units ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VAR_SAMP(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST, i.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.building_type_name, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geometric_mean_area, AVG(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.building_type_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS subject_rank_in_department FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, ic.subject_rank_in_department FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.total_departments, CASE WHEN tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < 5 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' WHEN tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 50 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, ic.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TOTAL_UNITS = stats.max_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_enrolled FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.max_lecture_units, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.LECTURE_UNITS = icte.max_lecture_units ORDER BY icte.max_lecture_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects, MAX(num_subjects) AS max_num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_DURATION = 'Full Term Subject' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM, VAR_SAMP(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.BUILDING_ROOM) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(variance_square_footage) AS highest_variance_square_footage FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_students_in_department FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE), year_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ys.units_range, ys.units_variance, ys.units_stddev, CASE WHEN ys.units_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ys.units_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM year_stats AS ys CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(units_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM year_stats) AS avg_stats ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN icte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN icte.avg_total_units < overall.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS overall ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS graduate_student_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS num_graduate_courses FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.graduate_student_count ORDER BY inner_cte.graduate_student_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_cte ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_cte.avg_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) AS overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, (inner_cte.avg_supervisees - overall.avg_all_supervisees) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_all_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST' AND ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES >= 1) AS overall
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_CODE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.window_column, t3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t3 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.dense_rank_num_enrolled, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE NULLS FIRST, lso.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = cso2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH tip_counts AS (SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID), per_year_stats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(tc.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM tip_counts AS tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, min_tip_materials, max_tip_materials, avg_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.min_tip_materials, i.max_tip_materials, i.avg_tip_materials, (i.avg_tip_materials - (SELECT AVG(avg_tip_materials) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME), top5_depts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_avg_units ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5), dept_stats AS (SELECT ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts AS t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS ic GROUP BY ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME), max_subjects AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TOTAL_UNITS FROM (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts AS t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS ic WHERE ic.rn = 1) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, ms.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM dept_stats AS ds JOIN max_subjects AS ms ON ds.DEPT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH building_room_areas AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_room_areas) SELECT bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bra.total_room_area FROM building_room_areas AS bra JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY CROSS JOIN stats WHERE bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND bra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area) SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area, COALESCE(SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA), 0) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_enrollment_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), max_enrollment_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN max_enrollment_per_year AS m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrollment JOIN avg_enrollment_per_year AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM dept_stats WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Science%'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, VAR_SAMP(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE NULLS FIRST), avg_rooms_per_type AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE JOIN avg_rooms_per_type AS art ON fb.BUILDING_TYPE = art.BUILDING_TYPE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > art.avg_num_of_rooms ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE NULLS FIRST, fb.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.num_subjects, (inner_cte.num_subjects - avg_counts.avg_num_subjects) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(num_subjects) AS avg_num_subjects FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH stats AS (SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS mean_area, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST), res_buildings AS (SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area, COUNT(*) AS num_history_records FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, rb.total_assignable_area, rb.num_history_records FROM res_buildings AS rb CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE rb.total_assignable_area > s.mean_area + s.stddev_area) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, total_assignable_area, num_history_records FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(total_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area, SUM(num_history_records) AS num_history_records FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), SchoolYearStats AS (SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT sys.SCHOOL_NAME, sys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sys.avg_total_units, sys.total_units_variance, sys.total_units_stddev FROM SchoolYearStats AS sys UNION ALL SELECT sys.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(sys.avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sys.avg_total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sys.avg_total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SchoolYearStats AS sys GROUP BY sys.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VAR_SAMP(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_units_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units_per_year AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST, deviation_from_avg DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subject_ranks AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST, ic.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, sr.SUBJECT_CODE AS top_subject_code, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sr.TOTAL_UNITS AS top_subject_total_units FROM dept_stats AS ds LEFT JOIN subject_ranks AS sr ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sr.rn = 1 ORDER BY ds.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range > inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST
