WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s2 WHERE s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology'))
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17') SELECT dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept.Graduate_Student_Count, subj.SUBJECT_CODE AS Most_Common_Subject_Code, subj.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(t2.FULL_NAME) AS Graduate_Student_Count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Graduate_Student_Count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) AS dept LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) AS subj ON dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subj.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept.Graduate_Student_Count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7')) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, d.SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > 12 THEN 'ABOVE_12' ELSE 'BELOW_12' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_var_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN i.total_units_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.total_units_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_var_cte AS a ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST, tso.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.DLC_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(org_count) AS avg_organization_count FROM (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d ON f.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME) AS sub) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.organization_count, a.avg_organization_count, CASE WHEN i.organization_count > a.avg_organization_count THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.organization_count < a.avg_organization_count THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, max_sub.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_enrollment, max_sub.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_with_max_enrollment, max_sub.max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) AS max_sub ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = max_sub.max_enrollment GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_sub.SUBJECT_ID, max_sub.SUBJECT_TITLE, max_sub.max_enrollment ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.HGN_DESC, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), YearlyTotals AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), YearlyUndergradCounts AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(CASE WHEN HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergrad_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), FilteredYears AS (SELECT yt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yt.total_lecture_units, yuc.undergrad_count, yuc.total_count FROM YearlyTotals AS yt JOIN YearlyUndergradCounts AS yuc ON yt.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yuc.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE CASE WHEN yuc.total_count > 0 THEN (CAST(1.0 * yuc.undergrad_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(yuc.total_count, 0)) ELSE 0 END >= 0.6) SELECT fy.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fy.total_lecture_units FROM FilteredYears AS fy WHERE fy.total_lecture_units > (SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM YearlyTotals)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance, ic.enrolled_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND cso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED, total_subjects.Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') AS total_subjects ON 1 = 1
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH schools_with_ps AS (SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), subject_units AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND NOT cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subjects.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN (SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_subjects ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled ORDER BY ic.total_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(running_sum_total_units) AS max_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) AS dept_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, (inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students - inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students) AS avg_minus_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled_students) AS highest_avg_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_with_max_units, cso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(cso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = cso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, MAX(CASE WHEN LECTURE_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) FROM inner_cte AS ic2 WHERE ic2.ACTIVITY_TITLE = inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND ic2.TERM_DESCRIPTION = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) THEN SUBJECT_TITLE ELSE NULL END) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) > 3
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students >= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 1.5 THEN 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students <= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 0.7 THEN 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled_students) AS avg_total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH total_assignable AS (SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fbh.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_assignable_area) AS mean_assignable, STDDEV(total_assignable_area) AS stddev_assignable FROM total_assignable) SELECT ta.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ta.total_assignable_area FROM total_assignable AS ta CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE ta.total_assignable_area > s.mean_assignable + s.stddev_assignable) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_assignable_area, fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, gt.Most_Common_Grade_Type, gt.Grade_Type_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE AS Most_Common_Grade_Type, COUNT(*) AS Grade_Type_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND at2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at2.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso2.GRADE_TYPE) AS sub)) AS gt ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.TERM_CODE = gt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, ic.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.department = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ict.SCHOOL_NAME, ict.avg_total_units, ict.var_total_units, ict.stddev_total_units, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) AS ict LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON ict.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME AND ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ict.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.COURSE = scd.COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH floors_with_rooms AS (SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR), academic_buildings AS (SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fwr.FLOOR, fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM academic_buildings AS ab JOIN floors_with_rooms AS fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), floor_stats AS (SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, COUNT(*) AS num_floors, MAX(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VAR_SAMP(ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG), max_floor AS (SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR AS max_assignable_area_floor, ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS max_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS m ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ic.ASSIGNABLE_AREA = m.max_area) SELECT fs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fs.num_floors, fs.assignable_area_range, fs.assignable_area_variance, mf.max_assignable_area_floor, mf.max_assignable_area FROM floor_stats AS fs LEFT JOIN max_floor AS mf ON fs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = mf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fs.num_floors DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sdo ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (ccso.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 15 OR ccso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3) AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> 'NIE' AND sdo.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sdo.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(avg_lecture_units) AS highest_avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_library_subjects FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tip ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, tip_counts.num_tip_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT tip.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tip.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tip GROUP BY tip.TERM_CODE) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = tip_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, aca.TERM_CODE HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, aca.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LSO.TERM_CODE, VAR_SAMP(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LSO.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_students_variance) AS highest_enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives'), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.avg_units, o.overall_avg_units, CASE WHEN d.avg_units > o.overall_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.avg_units < o.overall_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_performance FROM dept_avg AS d CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.geometric_mean_total_units, (i.geometric_mean_total_units - s.avg_geometric_mean) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS s ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT inner_cte.building_type_name, inner_cte.geometric_mean_area, Total_Rooms.total_rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE) AS Total_Rooms ON inner_cte.building_type_name = Total_Rooms.building_type_name
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_math_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST, sc.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Department_With_Highest_Subject_Code_Variance, stats.subject_code_variance, stats.subject_code_stddev FROM (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VAR_SAMP(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS BIGINT)) AS subject_code_variance, STDDEV(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS BIGINT)) AS subject_code_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS stats JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(subject_code_variance) AS max_variance FROM (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VAR_SAMP(CAST(ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AS BIGINT)) AS subject_code_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS maxvar ON stats.SCHOOL_NAME = maxvar.SCHOOL_NAME AND stats.subject_code_variance = maxvar.max_variance ORDER BY stats.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(icte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(icte.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VAR_SAMP(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.record_count_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, sos.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME <> 'School of Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_course_number_ascii) AS highest_avg_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_students DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ic.avg_enrolled_students
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32')) SELECT SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_FLOOR AS ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE COURSE IN (SELECT COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE COURSE_LEVEL = 'G')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME, b.CAMPUS_SECTOR, i.room_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY i.room_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), floor_room_areas AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ffl.FLOOR, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ffl ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ffl.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ffl.FLOOR), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM floor_room_areas) SELECT fra.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fra.FLOOR, fra.total_room_area, (fra.total_room_area - stats.mean_area) AS deviation_from_avg FROM floor_room_areas AS fra CROSS JOIN stats WHERE fra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ic.avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ic.avg_total_units) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ic.avg_total_units) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_required_textbooks FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, min_enrolled, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS dept_totals) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18') SELECT c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS library_faculty, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS tip_faculty FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_total_units_3rows, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE) SELECT ic.BUILDING_USE, ic.area_variance, bh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_with_largest_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.BUILDING_USE ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS bh ON ic.BUILDING_USE = bh.BUILDING_USE AND bh.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS lib ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = lib.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = lib.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON c.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON inner_cte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_hr_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL AND NOT t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.max_hr_org_unit_id, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON i.max_hr_org_unit_id = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VAR_SAMP(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE, inner_cte.avg_num_rooms, inner_cte.num_rooms_range, inner_cte.num_rooms_variance, SUM(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING ON inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE = FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE, inner_cte.avg_num_rooms, inner_cte.num_rooms_range, inner_cte.num_rooms_variance ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0), year_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, y.avg_total_units, y.var_total_units, y.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > y.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < y.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN year_stats AS y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, i.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Popular_Course, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE) ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), dept_avg AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled
