WITH inner_cte AS (WITH schools_with_ps AS (SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), subject_units AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND NOT cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, coefficient_of_variation, department_count FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count FROM (SELECT su.TOTAL_UNITS, su.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND NOT cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) AS su) AS overall
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(ic.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, (ic.LECTURE_UNITS - avg_lecture.avg_lecture_units) AS deviation_from_avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte) AS avg_lecture ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, avg_lecture.avg_lecture_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5), subject_counts AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_START_DATE, ic.max_enrollment, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN subject_counts AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.TERM_START_DATE = sc.TERM_START_DATE UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS max_enrollment, SUM(sc.total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM subject_counts AS sc GROUP BY sc.TERM_START_DATE ORDER BY TERM_START_DATE NULLS FIRST, DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Chemistry.Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total_Chemistry_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') AS Total_Chemistry ON 1 = 1
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_units_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units_cte AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ss2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, ss2.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ss.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Biology') AS ss2 ON ic.department_name = ss2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ss2.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.department_name NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, VAR_SAMP(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, variance_square_footage FROM inner_cte WHERE variance_square_footage > (SELECT AVG(variance_square_footage) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, CASE WHEN ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED > avg_stats.avg_max_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED < avg_stats.avg_max_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(MAX_NUM_ENROLLED) AS avg_max_enrolled FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, sc.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, CASE WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'GRADUATE' WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'UNDERGRADUATE' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS course_level_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.range_enrolled, inner_cte.var_enrolled, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.range_enrolled, inner_cte.var_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_units AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, a.avg_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, i.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Math_Subjects.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Math_Subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Math_Subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.department, ic.academic_year, ic.subject_count, ic.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.academic_year ORDER BY ic.department NULLS FIRST, ic.academic_year NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > 20 ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS NUM_LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATERIALS FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST) AS course_level_dense_rank FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd2 WHERE scd2.SCHOOL_NAME = inner_cte.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME AND scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G') AS num_courses_in_same_school FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS overall ON inner_cte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN cte.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coeff_var * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN cte.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coeff_var * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coeff_var FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, AVG(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enroll FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment, a.avg_enroll, CASE WHEN i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enroll * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrollment < a.avg_enroll * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS ls ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ls.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Course_Enrollment FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5) AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i1 JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS i2 ON i1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = i2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enrolled) AS c ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS dept_code, i.area_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS total_degree_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_cip_code, ic.total_degree_courses, sc.SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, sc.Course_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS Course_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME) AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS ic1) AS ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.department, inner_cte.academic_year, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.academic_year ORDER BY inner_cte.department NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.academic_year NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_total_units >= 9 ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(inner_cte.subject_count, 0)) AS avg_enrolled_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE (CAST(inner_cte.total_enrolled * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(inner_cte.subject_count, 0)) > (SELECT CAST(SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID), 0) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_all_departments) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_all_departments FROM (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(i.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS num_math_subjects, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, (i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, i.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON inner_cte.department_name = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY) AS sd ON inner_cte.department_name = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.department_name NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS highest_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.COST_CENTER_CODE = fbh.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 100000 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT') SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS max_assignable_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY max_assignable_area DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE), building_totals AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 0 AND fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.BUILDING_NAME), max_building AS (SELECT bt.BUILDING_TYPE, bt.BUILDING_NAME FROM (SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, MAX(total_area) AS max_area FROM building_totals GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE) AS bmax JOIN building_totals AS bt ON bt.BUILDING_TYPE = bmax.BUILDING_TYPE AND bt.total_area = bmax.max_area) SELECT ic.building_type_name, ic.geometric_mean_area, mb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_with_largest_total_room_area FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN max_building AS mb ON ic.building_type_name = mb.BUILDING_TYPE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.MIT_ID, t0.FULL_NAME, t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY t0.MIT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SE_PERSON AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.FULL_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '6') SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, MAX(MIT_ID) AS highest_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_enrolled_students, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.department_name JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON tso.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ic.department_name, ic.total_enrolled_students
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tip ON so.TERM_CODE = tip.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_subjects_offered, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_subjects_offered ORDER BY ic.num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units ORDER BY i.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.total_units_stddev, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_math_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.total_units_stddev, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_units_stddev DESC NULLS LAST, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed ON inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ss.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ic.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM dept_stats), SchoolDeptCounts AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME), SchoolDeptStats AS (SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_students_per_year FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SchoolDeptCounts AS sdc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, num_degree_granting_departments, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptStats UNION ALL SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_degree_granting_departments, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_students_per_year FROM SchoolDeptCounts AS sdc ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM (SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.enrolled_students_variance, dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Top_Dept, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students FROM (SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5) AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUM(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC NULLS LAST) AS dept_rank FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)), CourseCounts AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM_COURSES FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cc.NUM_COURSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN CourseCounts AS cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', NULL, NULL, SUM(NUM_COURSES) FROM CourseCounts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptEnrolledUnits AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptMaxEnrolledFaculty AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT deu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, deu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deu.min_num_enrolled_students, deu.avg_total_units, dmef.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dmef.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptEnrolledUnits AS deu JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledFaculty AS dmef ON deu.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmef.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY deu.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST), SchoolUnitsGeoMean AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM StudentInfo AS si JOIN SchoolUnitsGeoMean AS sgm ON si.SCHOOL_NAME = sgm.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY si.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), UnitsRangeVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, urv.units_range, urv.units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cov JOIN UnitsRangeVariance AS urv ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MathSubjects AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, c.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows FROM AcademicYearStats AS ays JOIN MathSubjects AS ms ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, ms.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, ms.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptTipLibrary AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5), CombinedDept AS (SELECT dtl.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtl.num_library_subjects, dtl.total_tip_enrollment, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptTipLibrary AS dtl LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_library_subjects, NULL AS total_tip_enrollment, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptVariation AS dv LEFT JOIN DeptTipLibrary AS dtl ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dtl.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL) SELECT * FROM CombinedDept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH CoefficientOfVariationByYear AS (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), AvgAndVarByYear AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, avgvar.avg_total_units, avgvar.var_total_units FROM CoefficientOfVariationByYear AS cov JOIN AvgAndVarByYear AS avgvar ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avgvar.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH TopDepartments AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), EngineeringEnrollment AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.SCHOOL_NAME, td.course_count, ee.total_enrolled FROM TopDepartments AS td JOIN EngineeringEnrollment AS ee ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subq2 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, NULL AS total_enrollments, 'Subject' AS Reason FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_enrollments, 'Department' AS Reason FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, total_enrollments, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptSubjectCodeStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dscs.SUBJECT_CODE, dscs.subject_code_count, dscs.min_dept_budget_code, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM DeptSubjectCodeStats AS dscs JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dscs.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5)), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH dept_total_enrolled AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST), eng_dept_max_enrollment AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, edm.max_enrollment, edm.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_total_enrolled AS dte LEFT JOIN eng_dept_max_enrollment AS edm ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edm.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH StddevTotalUnits AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5), GeometricMeanEnrollment AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_enrollment FROM StddevTotalUnits AS s JOIN GeometricMeanEnrollment AS g ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), Subq2 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.dense_rank_num_enrolled, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS dept_full_name_2019FA FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH political_science_students AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), dept_subject_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.FIRST_NAME, ps.LAST_NAME, ps.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.max_dept_budget_code, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units FROM political_science_students AS ps LEFT JOIN dept_subject_stats AS ds ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_enrolled_grad_students, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.stddev_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH TopMathCourses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3), DeptStudentVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation FROM TopMathCourses AS tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DeptStudentVariation AS dsv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC NULLS LAST, dsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH SubjectUnitsCV AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST), IAPMaxEnrollStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev FROM SubjectUnitsCV AS s JOIN IAPMaxEnrollStats AS i ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH TopDepartments AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), MathSubjectCodes AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.subject_count, msc.SUBJECT_CODE, msc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, msc.SCHOOL_NAME, msc.window_column FROM TopDepartments AS td JOIN MathSubjectCodes AS msc ON td.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, msc.window_column NULLS FIRST
