WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, subq1.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptUnitsStats1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), DeptUnitsStats2 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_subjects_with_enrollment, d1.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_subjects_with_enrollment, d2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_letter_graded_offered_this_year, d2.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_letter_graded_offered_this_year FROM DeptUnitsStats1 AS d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats2 AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectChemistryStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), SubjectReserveStats AS (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_CODE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.max_enrolled_students, r.num_reserved_materials, r.min_academic_year FROM SubjectChemistryStats AS s JOIN SubjectReserveStats AS r ON s.SUBJECT_TITLE = r.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, s.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST), engineering_enrollment AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, ee.total_enrolled FROM dept_enrollment_stats AS des LEFT JOIN engineering_enrollment AS ee ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrolled_stddev, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH ChemSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), DeptStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM ChemSubjects AS c LEFT JOIN DeptStats AS d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, c.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH MaxEnrollmentPerDept AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.total_enrollment, mepd.max_enrollment, mepd.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN MaxEnrollmentPerDept AS mepd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mepd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE dss.total_enrollment > 100 ORDER BY dss.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), TopZoeDepts AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolled AS d JOIN TopZoeDepts AS t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), RangeAndVariance AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cv.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, rv.total_units_range, rv.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cv JOIN RangeAndVariance AS rv ON cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = rv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH eng_eecs_grad_enrollment_2019 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT eee.SUBJECT_ID, eee.SUBJECT_TITLE, eee.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eee.num_enrolled_grad_students, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM eng_eecs_grad_enrollment_2019 AS eee LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS des ON eee.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH EnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), TipStats AS (WITH tip_counts AS (SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID), per_year_stats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VAR_SAMP(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts AS tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrollment_range, e.enrollment_variance, e.enrollment_stddev, t.range_tip_materials, t.var_tip_materials, t.stddev_tip_materials FROM EnrollmentStats AS e JOIN TipStats AS t ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY e.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptYearSubjectStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dys.department, dys.academic_year, dys.subject_count, dys.min_term_start_date, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students FROM DeptYearSubjectStats AS dys JOIN DeptEnrolledStats AS des ON dys.department = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE des.avg_enrolled_students > 10 ORDER BY dys.department NULLS FIRST, dys.academic_year NULLS FIRST
WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), dept_cv AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), polsci_programs AS (SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17') SELECT pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pcv.coefficient_of_variation, pp.PROGRAM_TITLE, pp.CATEGORY_TITLE, pp.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, pp.window_column FROM dept_cv AS pcv JOIN polsci_programs AS pp ON pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = pp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, pp.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH student_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), DepartmentStudentStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathSubjectStats AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.num_unique_subjects, mss.min_total_units FROM DepartmentStudentStats AS dss LEFT JOIN MathSubjectStats AS mss ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptEnrolledStatsGrad AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DeptEnrolledStatsAll AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d2.avg_enrolled, d2.range_enrolled, d2.var_enrolled FROM DeptEnrolledStatsGrad AS d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledStatsAll AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST, d2.avg_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST
WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cov JOIN EnrolledStats AS es ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH MathUnitsStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), MathFallUnitsVariance AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.total_units_range, mfs.total_units_variance, mfuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfuv.variance_total_units FROM MathUnitsStats AS mfs JOIN MathFallUnitsVariance AS mfuv ON mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST), EngrEnrolled AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), CombinedDept AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_range, d.enrolled_variance, d.enrolled_stddev, NULL AS total_enrolled, 'DeptStats' AS Reason FROM DeptStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, e.total_enrolled, 'EngrEnrolled' AS Reason FROM EngrEnrolled AS e) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, enrolled_stddev, total_enrolled, Reason FROM CombinedDept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.GRADE_TYPE, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, des.geometric_mean_enrollment FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, des.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH EnrolledStddev AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), UnitsStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrolled_stddev, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStddev AS e JOIN UnitsStats AS u ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY e.enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptStddev AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5), TopDeptStudents AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND (d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), CombinedDeptInfo AS (SELECT tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tds.SCHOOL_NAME, tds.student_count, ds.stddev_total_units FROM TopDeptStudents AS tds LEFT JOIN DeptStddev AS ds ON tds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, student_count, stddev_total_units FROM CombinedDeptInfo ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH MathCourseStats AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), MathYearStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.SUBJECT_TITLE, mcs.TOTAL_UNITS, mcs.GRADE_TYPE, mcs.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mys.variance_total_units, mys.stddev_total_units FROM MathCourseStats AS mcs JOIN MathYearStats AS mys ON mcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mcs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH MathDeptStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptSubjectCodeCounts AS (WITH dept_code_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), stats AS (SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts AS d CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY d.subject_code_count DESC NULLS LAST, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.num_unique_courses, mds.num_students, dscc.subject_code_count FROM MathDeptStats AS mds LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCodeCounts AS dscc ON mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dscc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH DeptStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), DeptCodeCounts AS (WITH dept_code_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), stats AS (SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts AS d CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count), CombinedDepts AS (SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.stddev_total_units, NULL AS subject_code_count, 'Stddev' AS Reason FROM DeptStddev AS d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS stddev_total_units, d2.subject_code_count, 'CodeCount' AS Reason FROM DeptCodeCounts AS d2) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, stddev_total_units, subject_code_count, Reason FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS min_enrolled_by_code FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MathEnrollments AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.total_enrollments FROM DeptEnrolledStats AS d LEFT JOIN MathEnrollments AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH StudentEECS AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST), SchoolGeomMeanUnits AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM StudentEECS AS s JOIN SchoolGeomMeanUnits AS g ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = g.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), UnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, u.total_units_range, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM EnrolledStats AS e JOIN UnitsStats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH UnitsStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), EnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, u.avg_total_units, u.var_total_units, u.stddev_total_units, e.enrollment_range, e.enrollment_variance, e.enrollment_stddev FROM UnitsStats AS u JOIN EnrollmentStats AS e ON u.ACADEMIC_YEAR = e.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY u.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH MathUnitsStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)), MathUnitsVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units, muv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, muv.total_units_variance, muv.total_units_stddev FROM MathUnitsStats AS mus JOIN MathUnitsVariance AS muv ON mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = muv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mus.total_units DESC NULLS LAST, muv.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH chemistry_windowed_enrollment AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), chemistry_subject_code_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) SELECT cwe.SUBJECT_TITLE, cwe.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cwe.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cwe.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cwe.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cwe.SCHOOL_NAME, cwe.window_column AS min_enrollment_windowed, cscw.SUBJECT_CODE, cscw.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cscw.window_column AS min_enrollment_by_subject_code FROM chemistry_windowed_enrollment AS cwe JOIN chemistry_subject_code_window AS cscw ON cwe.SUBJECT_TITLE = cscw.SUBJECT_TITLE AND cwe.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = cscw.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND cwe.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = cscw.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH DepartmentEnrolledStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats AS des JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE des.enrolled_variance > 0 AND dus.avg_total_units > 0 ORDER BY des.enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH AcademicYearUnitsStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AcademicYearUnitsRange AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, ayr.total_units_range, ayr.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_range FROM AcademicYearUnitsStats AS ays JOIN AcademicYearUnitsRange AS ayr ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ayr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE ays.total_units_variance > 0 AND ayr.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY ays.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DepartmentEnrolledStudents AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringEECS_Courses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, ecc.COURSE, ecc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ecc.SCHOOL_NAME, ecc.window_column FROM DepartmentEnrolledStudents AS des JOIN EngineeringEECS_Courses AS ecc ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ecc.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST, ecc.COURSE NULLS FIRST
WITH CourseMaxCIP AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING NOT MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NULL), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT cmc.COURSE, cmc.max_cip_program_code, cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment FROM CourseMaxCIP AS cmc JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS dse ON cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dse.total_enrollment > 100 ORDER BY dse.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AvgVarTotalUnits AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gm.geometric_mean_record_count, av.avg_total_units, av.var_total_units FROM GeometricMeanRecordCount AS gm JOIN AvgVarTotalUnits AS av ON gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = av.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = av.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH TopMathCourses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3), MathDeptUnitsStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdu.total_units_stddev FROM TopMathCourses AS tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tmc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitsStddev AS mdu ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance FROM DeptCourseStats AS dcs JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST
WITH AvgStddevUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), VarianceUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, v.total_units_variance FROM AvgStddevUnits AS a JOIN VarianceUnits AS v ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH AssignableAreaStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.COST_CENTER_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME <> 'BROWN BUILDING' GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY assignable_area_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT fbh.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VAR_SAMP(fr.AREA) AS var_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' OR fbh.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' GROUP BY fbh.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT aas.BUILDING_NAME, aas.assignable_area_stddev, ras.avg_area, ras.var_area FROM AssignableAreaStddev AS aas JOIN RoomAreaStats AS ras ON aas.BUILDING_NAME = ras.BUILDING_NAME
WITH dept_units_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_fall_subjects AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.subject_count FROM dept_units_stats AS dus LEFT JOIN math_fall_subjects AS mfs ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials AS drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.PROGRAM_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM CIP AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.PROGRAM_CODE = t1.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.PROGRAM_TITLE, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH ChemistryDeptStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), MathDeptStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.subject_count, c.min_total_units, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.avg_total_units, m.stddev_total_units FROM ChemistryDeptStats AS c JOIN MathDeptStats AS m ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrollment, d1.enrollment_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, 'Avg/Var' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, d2.coefficient_of_variation, 'CoeffVar' AS Reason FROM DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS d2) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH department_geometric_mean AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), eecs_subjects AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT egm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, egm.geometric_mean_enrolled_students, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department FROM department_geometric_mean AS egm JOIN eecs_subjects AS es ON egm.DEPARTMENT_CODE = es.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH top_departments AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), engineering_enrollment AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.SCHOOL_NAME, td.course_count, ee.total_enrolled FROM top_departments AS td LEFT JOIN engineering_enrollment AS ee ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH chemistry_materials_enrollment AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), degree_granting_departments_enrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cme.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cme.avg_enrollment, cme.enrollment_variance, dgde.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgde.avg_enrolled_students, dgde.range_enrolled_students, dgde.var_enrolled_students FROM chemistry_materials_enrollment AS cme CROSS JOIN degree_granting_departments_enrollment AS dgde
WITH geometric_mean_materials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), avg_var_units AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmm.geometric_mean_record_count, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM geometric_mean_materials AS gmm JOIN avg_var_units AS avu ON gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmm.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VAR_SAMP(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN (SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), student_year_stats AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count_range, s1.subject_count_variance, s1.subject_count_stddev, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students FROM subject_code_stats AS s1 LEFT JOIN student_year_stats AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DeptStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5), DeptStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.stddev_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_enrolled, NULL AS range_enrolled, NULL AS var_enrolled, 'Stddev' AS Reason FROM DeptStddev AS d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, d2.avg_enrolled, d2.range_enrolled, d2.var_enrolled, 'Stats' AS Reason FROM DeptStats AS d2) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH EngineeringVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MathDeptStats AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ev.enrolled_students_variance, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.num_unique_subjects, ms.min_total_units FROM EngineeringVariance AS ev JOIN MathDeptStats AS ms ON ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH MathSubjects AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows, c.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, c.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST), MathFallLibraryAgg AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, mfla.min_academic_year, mfla.sum_total_units FROM MathSubjects AS ms LEFT JOIN MathFallLibraryAgg AS mfla ON ms.SUBJECT_ID = mfla.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, ms.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectRecordCountVariance AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VAR_SAMP(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MathSubjectsWindowed AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.record_count_variance, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column FROM SubjectRecordCountVariance AS s JOIN MathSubjectsWindowed AS m ON s.SUBJECT_TITLE = m.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST), MathSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.stddev_total_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column FROM DeptStddev AS d UNION ALL SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS stddev_total_units, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.window_column FROM MathSubjects AS m) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5') SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.variance_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.avg_enrolled FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_total_units, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH enrolled_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR), units_stats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, us.avg_total_units, us.stddev_total_units FROM enrolled_stats AS es JOIN units_stats AS us ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MathCoeffVar AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, mcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptEnrolledStats AS des LEFT JOIN MathCoeffVar AS mcv ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH MathUnitsByYearDept AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)), MathUnitsStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mbyd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mbyd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mbyd.total_units, mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mus.avg_total_units, mus.stddev_total_units FROM MathUnitsByYearDept AS mbyd JOIN MathUnitsStats AS mus ON mbyd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mbyd.total_units DESC NULLS LAST
