d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sc_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_enrolled, subq1.avg_enrolled_per_subject, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.window_column, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3), math_subjects AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON ss.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.highest_enrollment, dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM math_subjects AS ms JOIN dept_units_stats AS dus ON ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top10_schools AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT t10.SCHOOL_NAME, t10.avg_total_units, t10.var_total_units, t10.stddev_total_units, t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, ds.Subject_Count, ic2.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM top10_schools AS t10 LEFT JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON t10.SCHOOL_NAME = ds.SCHOOL_NAME AND t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t10.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST

COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), cte1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.department = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ic.department, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.earliest_term_start_date, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.var_enrolled_students, s2.stddev_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH highest_avg_enrollment_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS highest_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), stddev_total_units_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT h.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.highest_avg_enrollment, s.stddev_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM highest_avg_enrollment_cte AS h JOIN stddev_total_units_cte AS s ON h.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY h.highest_avg_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST, h.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), school_max_avg_enrollment AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept FROM dept_enrollment_stats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), chemistry_subjects_ranked AS (SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.dense_rank_num_enrolled, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') AS inner_cte JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT smax.SCHOOL_NAME, smax.highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept, csr.SUBJECT_TITLE, csr.dense_rank_num_enrolled, csr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, csr.SCHOOL_NAME AS chemistry_school_name FROM school_max_avg_enrollment AS smax CROSS JOIN chemistry_subjects_ranked AS csr
WITH inner_cte_math AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), math_dept AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte_math AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte_chem AS (SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), chem_top10 AS (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte_chem ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), chem_school_count AS (SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Represented_School, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte_chem GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.Most_Represented_School, s.Subject_Count FROM math_dept AS m CROSS JOIN chem_top10 AS c LEFT JOIN chem_school_count AS s ON c.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s.Most_Represented_School ORDER BY c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), dept_avg AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq2 AS (SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.min_total_units, inner_cte2.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte2 WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.min_total_units, inner_cte2.sum_lecture_units) SELECT q1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, q1.COURSE_LEVEL, q1.course_count, q1.min_total_units AS min_total_units_subq1, q2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, q2.min_total_units AS min_total_units_subq2, q2.sum_lecture_units, q2.num_unique_subjects FROM subq1 AS q1 JOIN subq2 AS q2 ON q1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = q2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY q1.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST, q2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST
WITH DepartmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, variance_num_enrolled_students, stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_num_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0)), EECS_Courses AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.variance_num_enrolled_students, ds.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ec.COURSE, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.SCHOOL_NAME, ec.window_column, ec.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM DepartmentStats AS ds JOIN EECS_Courses AS ec ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ec.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.subject_count, s2.total_enrolled_students FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.total_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte1.stddev_enrolled_students, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), Subquery2 AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM inner_cte2 WHERE total_enrolled > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM inner_cte2)) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s1.stddev_enrolled_students, s1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_enrolled FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s2.total_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST
WITH BioSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_enrolled_students, i.var_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_subjects, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_enrolled_students, i.var_enrolled_students, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST), MathSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), CombinedResults AS (SELECT b.ACADEMIC_YEAR, b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, b.avg_enrolled_students, b.var_enrolled_students, b.num_subjects, NULL AS highest_avg_total_units, 'Biology' AS Source FROM BioSubjects AS b UNION ALL SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS var_enrolled_students, NULL AS num_subjects, m.highest_avg_total_units, 'Mathematics' AS Source FROM MathSubjects AS m) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, Source NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_enrolled_students HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_enrolled_students, s1.num_subjects_offered, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH dept_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0), math_subjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.stddev_total_units, ds.num_grad_students, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.window_column, ms.unit_category FROM dept_stats AS ds JOIN math_subjects AS ms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH total_enrolled_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS t)), coefficient_variation_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT tec.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tec.total_enrolled_students, cvc.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM total_enrolled_cte AS tec JOIN coefficient_variation_cte AS cvc ON tec.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cvc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH subject_code_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), math_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation HAVING AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.subject_code_count_variance, scs.subject_code_count_stddev, scs.avg_subject_code_count, mes.coefficient_of_variation, mes.avg_enrolled_students FROM subject_code_stats AS scs LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_stats AS mes ON scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY scs.subject_code_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE s2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject > 0 ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_course_count, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_range, s2.enrollment_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = > 5) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.COURSE, inner_cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.max_enrollment, cte1.SUBJECT_ID, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.subject_rank_in_dept, cte2.COURSE, cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.window_column, cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VAR_SAMP(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ic.STUDENT_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.num_student_years, s2.STUDENT_YEAR, s2.num_students, s2.avg_students_per_year, s2.range_students_per_year, s2.var_students_per_year, s1.highest_enrollment FROM subq2 AS s2 LEFT JOIN subq1 AS s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s2.STUDENT_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH cv_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_cv AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_cv AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv), materials_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation, materials_cte.highest_material_count_for_status FROM cv_cte JOIN materials_cte ON cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = materials_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) + STDDEV(total_enrollment) FROM (SELECT SUM(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sub)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrollment, ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.total_units_variance, ic2.total_units_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS CC_DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrollment, ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.total_units_variance, ic2.total_units_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic2.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enroll FROM inner_cte1), enrollment_summary AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.total_enrollment, a.avg_enroll, CASE WHEN i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enroll * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrollment < a.avg_enroll * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE), subject_summary AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.total_enrollment, es.avg_enroll, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrollment_category = 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' ORDER BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ss.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, at.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND inner_cte.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS latest_term_end_date FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, FIRST, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DepartmentsWithHighAvgUnits AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dwhau.avg_total_units, dwhau.stddev_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM DepartmentsWithHighAvgUnits AS dwhau JOIN inner_cte2 AS icte ON dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dwhau.avg_total_units, dwhau.stddev_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY dwhau.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(student_count) AS variance_of_grad_students FROM (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte_dept_variance AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.variance_of_grad_students, (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT) AS grad_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON grad_counts.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_counts ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.TERM_CODE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.max_total_units_3rows, d.variance_of_grad_students, d.benchmark, d.variance_category FROM cte_math_subjects AS m JOIN cte_dept_variance AS d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER NULLS FIRST, m.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND FIRST, m.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST, s.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH AcademicYearStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Most_Offered_Department, dept.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS dept_rank FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cte ON icte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_cte.avg_variance) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_range, ays.total_units_variance, ays.Most_Offered_Department, ays.Subject_Count, dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(i.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, num_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE num_courses = (SELECT MAX(num_courses) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance, s1.total_units_stddev, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.num_courses FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST), math_tip_summary AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_library_max AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_range, icte.enrollment_variance, mts.min_num_enrolled_students, mts.avg_total_units, mlm.max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN math_tip_summary AS mts ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mts.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN math_library_max AS mlm ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mlm.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.total_unique_subjects, dus.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dus ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), UnitsStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cov JOIN UnitsStats AS us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ccso.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) OR atp.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM'))
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), CurrentYearMathStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedMathStats AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.range_total_units, i.var_total_units, i.max_total_units, i.min_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'Yearly' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, NULL AS max_total_units, NULL AS min_total_units, c.total_units_variance, c.total_units_stddev, 'CurrentTerm' AS Reason FROM CurrentYearMathStats AS c) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, max_total_units, min_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedMathStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dcov.coefficient_of_variation FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des JOIN DepartmentCoefficientOfVariation AS dcov ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcov.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE des.avg_enrollment > 30 AND dcov.coefficient_of_variation < 1 ORDER BY des.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, des.enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), SchoolRollup AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, coefficient_of_variation FROM SchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS mus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ChemDeptStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_chem_courses_with_material FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.range_enrolled_students, d.var_enrolled_students, c.avg_enrollment, c.enrollment_variance, c.num_chem_courses_with_material FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS d LEFT JOIN ChemDeptStats AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentSubjectCodeStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VAR_SAMP(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), TopSubjectsByDepartmentYear AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.subject_count, d.subject_count_range, LAST, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.subject_count_range, icte.subject_count_variance, icte.subject_count_stddev, WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), TopZoeDepts AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students FROM DeptEnrolled AS d JOIN TopZoeDepts AS t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, ic.unique_students, MAX(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrolled_in_subject FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = su.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, ic.unique_students

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dmu.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0) AS dmu ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_TIP, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME_TIP FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND
