MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.coefficient_of_variation, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_range, us.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cov JOIN UnitsStatistics AS us ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, COALESCE(fall_count.num_fall_subjects, 0) AS num_fall_math_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_fall_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE WHERE sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND aca.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS fall_count ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = fall_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = fall_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), coefficient_variation AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), math_courses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.coefficient_of_variation, mc.COURSE_LEVEL, mc.course_count, mc.min_cip_code FROM coefficient_variation AS cv LEFT JOIN math_courses AS mc ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code, mcu.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON c.DEPARTMENT = ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) AS mcu ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcu.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = mcu.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ic.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CourseMaxCIP AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING NOT MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NULL), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT cmc.COURSE, cmc.max_cip_program_code, cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment FROM CourseMaxCIP AS cmc JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS dse ON cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dse.total_enrollment > 100), DepartmentTotals AS (SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS max_cip_program_code, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, SUM(dse.total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dse GROUP BY dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.max_cip_program_code, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS max_cip_program_code, dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, dt.total_enrollment FROM DepartmentTotals AS dt ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST, total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), UnitsStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ccso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN UnitsStats AS u ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY i.enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST, u.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), LibraryReserveStats AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS count_unique_subjects FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, lrs.min_academic_year, lrs.sum_total_units, lrs.count_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN LibraryReserveStats AS lrs WHERE icte.total_units_variance > 0 AND lrs.sum_total_units > 0 AND lrs.count_unique_subjects >= 1 ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER), Total_Courses AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Math_Library_Subjects AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Math_Library_Subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, tc.Total_Courses, mls.Math_Library_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN Total_Courses AS tc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN Math_Library_Subjects AS mls ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mls.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3), ChemDeptUnitsStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.offer_count, mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdu.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ChemDeptUnitsStddev AS mdu ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_library_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, urv.units_range, urv.units_variance FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS gmr JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS urv ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, MAX(CSO.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ATA ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ATA.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ATA.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS ATP ON ATA.TERM_CODE = ATP.TERM_CODE AND ATP.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CSO ON CSO.TERM_CODE = ATA.TERM_CODE AND CSO.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), TopZoeStudents AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), DeptSubjectCount AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students, s.num_subjects FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN TopZoeStudents AS t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCount AS s ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), department_student_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_subjects_stats AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.num_unique_subjects, mss.min_total_units FROM department_student_stats AS dss LEFT JOIN math_subjects_stats AS mss ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_students, inner_cte.stddev_num_students, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, msc.num_distinct_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_distinct_subject_codes FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS msc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = msc.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE), dept_stats AS (SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), AcademicYearStats2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), AvgLectureUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, AcademicYearStats2.total_units_variance, AvgLectureUnits.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN AcademicYearStats2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AcademicYearStats2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = AcademicYearStats2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN AvgLectureUnits ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AvgLectureUnits.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = AvgLectureUnits.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST, AcademicYearStats2.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), math_units_variation AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), required_materials_count AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS num_required_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.window_column, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, COALESCE(r.num_required_materials, 0) AS num_required_materials FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN math_units_variation AS m LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE = t.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN required_materials_count AS r ON t.TERM_CODE = r.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = r.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.course_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.COURSE = s.COURSE_NUMBER AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, c.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST), MathDeptTotals AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_titles FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.stddev_enrolled_students, m.total_enrolled, m.num_unique_titles FROM inner_cte AS d LEFT JOIN MathDeptTotals AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VAR_SAMP(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN (SELECT cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON cd.DEPARTMENT = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subject_stats ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = course_subject_stats.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), student_year_stats AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, VAR_SAMP(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count_range, i.subject_count_variance, i.subject_count_stddev, s.variance_num_students, s.stddev_num_students FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN student_year_stats AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), coefficient_variation AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), math_max_enrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.coefficient_of_variation, mme.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mme.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM coefficient_variation AS cv LEFT JOIN math_max_enrollment AS mme ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mme.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE (ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), LibraryAndTipEnrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5) SELECT lat.DEPARTMENT_CODE, lat.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lat.num_library_subjects, lat.total_tip_enrollment, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM LibraryAndTipEnrollment AS lat JOIN CoefficientOfVariation AS cov ON lat.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cov.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.num_library_subjects, icte.total_tip_enrollment, icte.coefficient_of_variation, lso.SUBJECT_ID AS library_subject_code, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST, lso.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_enrollment_stddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Bio_Enrolled_Stats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST), Math_Units_Stats AS (WITH term_units AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_per_term FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(total_units_per_term) - MIN(total_units_per_term) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(total_units_per_term) AS units_variance, STDDEV(total_units_per_term) AS units_stddev, AVG(total_units_per_term) AS avg_units_per_term FROM term_units GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST) SELECT b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, b.avg_enrolled_students, b.var_enrolled_students, m.units_range, m.units_variance, m.units_stddev, m.avg_units_per_term FROM Bio_Enrolled_Stats AS b JOIN Math_Units_Stats AS m ON b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY b.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.units_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students > inner_cte.avg_units_per_term * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students < inner_cte.avg_units_per_term * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Physics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte AS c LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.max_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, icte.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN icte.avg_enrolled_students > oa.overall_avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN icte.avg_enrolled_students < oa.overall_avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY icte.course_count DESC NULLS LAST, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_enrolled_students, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS subject_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' ORDER BY icte.num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_avg_var_excl_bio AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_avg_range_var_excl_chem AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrolled_students, d1.var_enrolled_students, d2.avg_enrolled, d2.range_enrolled, d2.var_enrolled FROM dept_avg_var_excl_bio AS d1 JOIN dept_avg_range_var_excl_chem AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, icte.avg_enrolled, icte.range_enrolled, icte.var_enrolled FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science'
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_enrollment AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), top_materials AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT tm.SUBJECT_TITLE, tm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tm.material_count, de.total_enrolled FROM top_materials AS tm JOIN dept_enrollment AS de ON tm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tm.material_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.material_count, icte.total_enrolled, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.material_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), SubjectCodeWindow AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrollment_by_subject_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), WindowedEnrollment AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS min_enrollment_windowed FROM inner_cte AS i), SchoolOfScienceEnrollment AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS total_enrolled, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS science_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT w.SUBJECT_TITLE, w.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, w.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, w.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, w.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, w.SCHOOL_NAME, w.min_enrollment_windowed, scw.SUBJECT_CODE, scw.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scw.min_enrollment_by_subject_code FROM WindowedEnrollment AS w JOIN SubjectCodeWindow AS scw ON w.SUBJECT_TITLE = scw.SUBJECT_TITLE AND w.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = scw.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND w.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = scw.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SchoolOfScienceEnrollment AS sse ON w.SUBJECT_ID = sse.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sse.science_enrolled >= 0.6 * sse.total_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgAreaStats AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5), BuildingFloorStats AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM OrgAreaStats AS oas JOIN BuildingFloorStats AS bfs ON oas.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.area_stddev, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.avg_assignable_area, icte.stddev_assignable_area, fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS most_recent_assignable_area FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT fbh1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh1 WHERE (fbh1.FISCAL_PERIOD, fbh1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) IN (SELECT MAX(fbh2.FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_period, fbh2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh2 GROUP BY fbh2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)) AS fbh ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_max_enrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.variance_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_num_enrolled_students, sme.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_enrollment, sme.SUBJECT_TITLE, sme.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN subject_max_enrollment AS sme ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sme.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sme.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_num_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, tsc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, tsc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') AS tsc JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tsc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

ccso.TERM_CODE = atall.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON ccso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atall.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS lib ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = lib.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathematicsUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, mus.avg_total_units, mus.total_units_variance, mus.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des JOIN MathematicsUnitsStats AS mus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte WHERE icte.avg_enrolled_students > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ORDER BY icte.avg_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance_1, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subquery2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment_2 FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_variance_1, inner_cte.total_units_stddev_1, subquery2.max_enrollment_2 FROM inner_cte JOIN subquery2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subquery2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = subquery2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance_1 DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), StudentSubjects AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, msd.FULL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT, sos.TERM_CODE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), StudentSubjectCounts AS (SELECT ss.FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM StudentSubjects AS ss GROUP BY ss.FULL_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sc.subject_count, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN StudentSubjectCounts AS sc ON s.FULL_NAME = sc.FULL_NAME JOIN StudentSubjects AS ss ON s.FULL_NAME = ss.FULL_NAME ORDER BY sc.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, s.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST, ss.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE), ranked_courses AS (SELECT cu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cu.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cu.SUBJECT_TITLE, cu.subject_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, Top_Subject_Number, rc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, rc.subject_total_units AS Top_Subject_Units, COALESCE(SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS Num_Enrolled_Students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ranked_courses AS rc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rc.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = rc.SUBJECT_NUMBER GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units, rc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, rc.SUBJECT_TITLE, rc.subject_total_units ORDER BY icte.total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
