WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'E%' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'E%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM DeptCourseStats AS dcs JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > 9
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_coefficient_of_variation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1), grad_subject_count AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, dept_coefficient_of_variation.coefficient_of_variation, grad_subject_count.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_coefficient_of_variation ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_coefficient_of_variation.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN grad_subject_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = grad_subject_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3), math_dept_units_stddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5), course_enrollment_avg AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.offer_count, mdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdu.total_units_stddev, cea.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN math_dept_units_stddev AS mdu LEFT JOIN course_enrollment_avg AS cea ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = cea.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_enrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), dept_units_stddev AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.total_enrollment, du.stddev_total_units FROM dept_enrollment AS de JOIN dept_units_stddev AS du ON de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.stddev_total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.stddev_total_units, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ORDER BY icte.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_in_building FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST, p.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, p.SUBJECT_ID, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, p.running_sum_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT, sos.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') AS p ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = p.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON p.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY department_name NULLS FIRST, s.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST, p.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST), IAPMaxEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), AvgTotalUnits AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CombinedStats AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev, a.avg_total_units FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS c LEFT JOIN IAPMaxEnrollmentStats AS i ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN AvgTotalUnits AS a ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev, a.avg_total_units FROM IAPMaxEnrollmentStats AS i LEFT JOIN CoefficientOfVariation AS c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN AvgTotalUnits AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Physics' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), BioUnitsStddev AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST) SELECT ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.window_column, bu.stddev_total_units, bu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN BioUnitsStddev AS bu ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = bu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, ic.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS math_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.math_avg_total_units, (inner_cte.math_avg_total_units - all_avg.all_subjects_avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_all_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS all_subjects_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS all_avg ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = all_avg.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), all_dept_avg AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_avg_enrollment FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), DeptUnitVariation AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN icte.avg_enrollment > oa.overall_avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN icte.avg_enrollment < oa.overall_avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa JOIN DeptUnitVariation AS duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dscs.avg_subject_codes, dscs.stddev_subject_codes, COALESCE(faculty_stats.num_unique_faculty, 0) AS num_unique_faculty FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dscs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dscs.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS num_unique_faculty FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS faculty_stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = faculty_stats.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, des.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH org_area_stddev AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5), building_floor_stats AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1) SELECT bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM building_floor_stats AS bfs LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN org_area_stddev AS oas ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE NOT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_assignable_area, ic.stddev_assignable_area, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_stddev, (fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA - COALESCE(hb.avg_hist_assignable_area, 0)) AS deviation_from_hist_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_hist_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS hb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = hb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), dept_subject_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), ranked_students AS (SELECT icte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY icte.max_dept_budget_code DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS icte) SELECT rs.FIRST_NAME, rs.LAST_NAME, rs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, rs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rs.SCHOOL_NAME, rs.max_dept_budget_code, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units FROM ranked_students AS rs LEFT JOIN dept_subject_stats AS ds ON rs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE rs.rn <= 10 ORDER BY rs.max_dept_budget_code DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.GRADE_TYPE, m.subject_count, m.min_total_units, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS m LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStats AS d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST, d.max_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjects2021 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST), student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VAR_SAMP(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds21.SCHOOL_NAME, ds21.num_subjects_offered, ds21.total_enrolled_students, dstat.avg_students_per_year, dstat.range_students_per_year, dstat.var_students_per_year FROM DeptSubjects2021 AS ds21 JOIN dept_stats AS dstat ON ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dstat.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds21.num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_enrolled_students, icte.avg_students_per_year, icte.range_students_per_year, icte.var_students_per_year, sc.STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year, sc.num_students AS Student_Year_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS sc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_enrollment_stddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5), dept_subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.stddev_num_enrolled_students, dscs.avg_subject_codes, dscs.stddev_subject_codes FROM dept_enrollment_stddev AS des JOIN dept_subject_code_stats AS dscs ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME), enrollment_variance_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(stddev_num_enrolled_students) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_subject_codes, ic.stddev_subject_codes, CASE WHEN ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students > evb.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students < evb.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS enrollment_variance_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN enrollment_variance_benchmark AS evb
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, stats.avg_total_units, stats.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL), dept_cv AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), polsci_programs AS (SELECT CIP.PROGRAM_TITLE, CIP.CATEGORY_TITLE, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM CIP JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON CIP.PROGRAM_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = '17') SELECT pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pcv.coefficient_of_variation, pp.PROGRAM_TITLE, pp.CATEGORY_TITLE, pp.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, pp.window_column FROM dept_cv AS pcv JOIN polsci_programs AS pp ON pcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = pp.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.PROGRAM_TITLE, inner_cte.CATEGORY_TITLE, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.window_column NULLS FIRST, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, ss.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST), RangeAndVariance AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, ss.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cov.SCHOOL_NAME, cov.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, rav.total_units_range, rav.total_units_variance FROM CoefficientOfVariation AS cov JOIN RangeAndVariance AS rav ON cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rav.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = rav.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND cov.SCHOOL_NAME = rav.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, cov.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST), BioStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS bio_subject_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, BioStats.coefficient_of_variation, BioStats.bio_subject_count FROM inner_cte JOIN BioStats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = BioStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (CAST(STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectCodeStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MostFrequentSubjectCode AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS offering_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON scd.COURSE = s.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, scs.subject_code_count_variance, scs.subject_code_count_stddev, mfsc.SUBJECT_CODE AS most_frequent_subject_code, mfsc.offering_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SubjectCodeStats AS scs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostFrequentSubjectCode AS mfsc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mfsc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE), dept_max_enroll AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VAR_SAMP(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subjects_per_term AS spt JOIN dept_terms AS dt ON spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_max_enroll AS dme ON spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.range_num_subjects, inner_cte.variance_num_subjects, inner_cte.stddev_num_subjects, inner_cte.max_enrollment, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM inner_cte JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, msd.FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dau.avg_total_units FROM dept_avg_units AS dau ORDER BY dau.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), most_common_student_year AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, mcs.STUDENT_YEAR AS most_common_student_year, mcs.student_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN most_common_student_year AS mcs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mcs.DEPARTMENT AND mcs.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.num_reserved_materials, icte.min_academic_year, s2.coefficient_of_variation, COALESCE(s3.num_unique_materials, 0) AS num_unique_materials FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0) AS s2 ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_unique_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS s3 ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = s3.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserved_materials, ic.min_academic_year, s2.coefficient_of_variation, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS total_unique_materials FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0) AS s2 ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS mat ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = mat.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = mat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AcademicYearStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.TERM_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, icte.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, dme.max_enrollment, sos_max.SUBJECT_TITLE, avg_enroll.avg_enrollment_2021fa FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN (SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos2.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dme ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos_max ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos_max.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos_max.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos_max.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment JOIN (SELECT sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos3.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_2021fa FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd3 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos3 ON sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos3.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd3.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd3.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('15', '7') AND sos3.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enroll ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, ds.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ds.coefficient_of_variation > 0.2 ORDER BY ds.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathUnitsStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT e.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathTopFaculty AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS faculty_subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT e.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled, d.range_enrolled, d.var_enrolled, m.avg_units, m.units_variance, m.subject_count, f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS top_faculty_name FROM inner_cte AS d LEFT JOIN MathUnitsStats AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM MathTopFaculty WHERE rn = 1) AS f ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = f.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE), year_avg AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(term_material_count) AS avg_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_CODE, i.term_material_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN year_avg AS y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.term_material_count > y.avg_material_count ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST, i.term_material_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE fr.AREA > 0 GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE UPPER(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'D%' AND ic.avg_area >= 100 ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_area DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.MIT_ID, t0.COURSE_NAME FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS t0 JOIN SE_PERSON AS t1 ON t0.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT = '18 - Mathematics' AND t0.UNIT = 'Hayden') SELECT icte.MIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) AS Num_Courses_Taught, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) DESC NULLS LAST) AS Instructor_Rank FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.MIT_ID ORDER BY Num_Courses_Taught DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.ROOM_NUMBER, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, cnt.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE NULLS FIRST, ic.BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER) SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY GROUP BY f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY hist_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST) = inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME END AS building_name, inner_cte.hist_count, f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.CAMPUS_SECTOR FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS f ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS overall ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, deviation_from_overall_avg DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VAR_SAMP(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER) SELECT i.TERM_PARAMETER, i.avg_materials_per_subject, i.variance_materials_per_subject, i.stddev_materials_per_subject, (i.avg_materials_per_subject - (SELECT AVG(avg_materials_per_subject) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.variance_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserve_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS unique_tip_material_statuses, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_record_count, MIN(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS earliest_term_description, MAX(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS latest_term_description FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS so ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = so.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = so.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND so.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N') SELECT i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS i2 ON i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enrolled ORDER BY i1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN ds.avg_total_units > os.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ds.avg_total_units < os.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS avg_total_units_category FROM dept_stats AS ds CROSS JOIN overall_stats AS os ORDER BY ds.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, SPACE_USAGE, floor_count, total_room_counter FROM inner_cte WHERE total_room_counter > (SELECT AVG(total_room_counter) FROM (SELECT SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY) AS sub)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, ic_recent.course_number AS most_recent_course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS most_recent_course_description FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, course_number, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic_recent ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic_recent.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic_recent.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic_recent.course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_courses DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE) AS subj_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE = subj_count.COURSE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.COURSE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), subject_code_avg AS (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subject_code_avg AS a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(ic.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS Required_Material_Count, mc.Most_Common_Material_Key, mc.Material_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS Most_Common_Material_Key, COUNT(*) AS Material_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS ic2 GROUP BY ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS mc ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = mc.SUBJECT_ID AND mc.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.Most_Common_Material_Key, mc.Material_Count ORDER BY Required_Material_Count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR
