WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s2 WHERE s2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s2.TOTAL_UNITS > 1)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students, year_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS Peak_Year_Desc, year_stats.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Enrolled_Students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5) AS dept_stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Year_Enrolled_Students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS year_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = year_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND year_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CLUSTER_TYPE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT SUBJECT_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TOTAL_UNITS, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > (SELECT AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME, b.NUM_OF_ROOMS, i.avg_room_area, i.room_area_range, i.room_area_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS b ON i.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY i.room_area_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(r.AREA) AS min_area, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.MAJOR_USE_DESC = 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.min_area, inner_cte.total_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN inner_cte ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.MAJOR_USE_DESC = 'RESIDENT' GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.min_area, inner_cte.total_rooms
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte) AS a ON i.geometric_mean_area > a.avg_geom_mean ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_area DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NAME AS HIST_BUILDING_NAME, t0.BUILDING_TYPE, t1.BUILDING_TYPE AS HIST_BUILDING_TYPE, t0.BUILDING_HEIGHT FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_CENTER_CODE = t1.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT NULLS FIRST) = BUILDING_NAME THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME END AS BUILDING_NAME, HIST_BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, HIST_BUILDING_TYPE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), avg_units_cte AS (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < a.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_units_cte AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24'), avg_codes AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT, AVG(CAST(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS REAL)) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, (CAST(i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS REAL) - a.avg_hr_dept_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_codes AS a ON i.SPACE_UNIT = a.SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, inner_cte.reserve_count, avg_stats.avg_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count > avg_stats.avg_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count < avg_stats.avg_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS status_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(reserve_count) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.reserve_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_non_current_term_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON td.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON lso.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.math_non_current_term_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td2 ON td2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance > (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance < (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.units_range >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.units_range <= 2 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_cte ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avg_cte.avg_enrollment >= 20
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, AVG(r.AREA) AS area_avg FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, i.area_stddev, i.area_avg, CASE WHEN i.area_stddev > i.area_avg * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_VARIANCE' WHEN i.area_stddev < i.area_avg * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC NULLS LAST), org_avg_area AS (SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN org_avg_area AS a ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND r.AREA > a.avg_area

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, ReserveCounts.Total_Reserve_Materials FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS Total_Reserve_Materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID) AS ReserveCounts ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ReserveCounts.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled_students, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ISBN, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON AS p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE) SELECT cte.PERSON_ROLE, cte.avg_max_enrollment, cte.max_enrollment_range, cte.max_enrollment_variance, CASE WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment > overall.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment < overall.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL) AS overall ORDER BY cte.max_enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, s_max.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_enrollment, s_max.max_enrollment FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5) AS d LEFT JOIN (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS m ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrollment) AS s_max ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s_max.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.avg_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.TERM_CODE >= '2011' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND TERM_CODE >= '2011') ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0) ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(inner_cte.total_materials) AS highest_term_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR IN (SELECT academic_year FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS year_total FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS year_totals WHERE year_total > (SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM (SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS sub)) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.total_max_enrollment, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY GROUP BY f.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, inner_cte.hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS f JOIN inner_cte ON f.BUILDING_NAME = inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units, COUNT(DISTINCT su.DLC_KEY) AS num_unique_dlc_keys FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > (SELECT AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, term_counts.total_activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS term_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = term_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(geometric_mean_record_count) AS max_geom_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS max_cte ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = max_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.geometric_mean_record_count = max_cte.max_geom_mean ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area') SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, m.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON i.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2009JA') SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2009JA'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_max_enrollment) AS avg_total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.activity_count, i.total_max_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_max_enrollment > a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.total_max_enrollment < a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_enrollment_per_term DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC NULLS LAST, SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' AND l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM inner_cte) AS o ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, window_column, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS') SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' AND TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.total_materials, subj_stats.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject, subj_stats.material_count AS Top_Subject_Material_Count FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS subj_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subj_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND subj_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.total_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.area_stddev, org.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS org_room_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = org.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND org.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT GRADE_TYPE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, r.AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(AREA) AS max_room_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY max_room_area DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records, MAX(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_library_warehouse_date, MAX(td.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records ORDER BY inner_cte.total_records DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t0.DEPT_NAMES, t0.SQFT, t0.MIT_ID, AVG(t0.SQFT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t0.RESEARCH_VOLUME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DEPT_NAMES = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES = 2) SELECT RESEARCH_VOLUME, DEPT_NAMES, SQFT, MIT_ID, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 200
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, (12 - c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS enrollment_minus_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.LECTURE_UNITS, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), dept_avg AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, (i.window_column - d.avg_lecture_units) AS diff_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, (MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)) AS units_difference FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_difference DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.org_unit_count, inner_cte.min_department_id, CASE WHEN inner_cte.org_unit_count >= 5 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.org_unit_count < 2 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS org_unit_size_category FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS min_access_level, COUNT(DISTINCT z.SPACE_USAGE) AS total_space_usages, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS z ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.min_access_level, i.total_space_usages FROM inner_cte AS i
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME HAVING AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, subj_counts.total_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS subj_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = subj_counts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT SUBJECT_DEPT, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_DEPT) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.GRADE_TYPE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg_units AS d ON i.SUBJECT_DEPT = d.SUBJECT_DEPT WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), dept_counts AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE), term_avgs AS (SELECT TERM_CODE, AVG(dept_subject_count) AS avg_subjects_per_dept FROM dept_counts GROUP BY TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.window_column, CASE WHEN d.dept_subject_count > t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.dept_subject_count < t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS dept_subjects_status FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_counts AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE JOIN term_avgs AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.org_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS AS current_num_rooms, VAR_SAMP(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance, STDDEV(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_stddev, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE f.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS) SELECT i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.current_num_rooms, i.num_rooms_variance, i.num_rooms_stddev, i.avg_hist_num_rooms, CASE WHEN i.current_num_rooms > i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.current_num_rooms < i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.BUILDING_TYPE NULLS FIRST, i.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.student_count) AS total_unique_students, MIN(ic.min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) AS top_depts JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE_LEVEL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, ic2.student_count AS Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic2 WHERE ic2.rn = 1) AS cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count ORDER BY total_unique_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST, total_library_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, t2.TERM_END_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, d.DEPT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, d.subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) DESC NULLS LAST) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS d ON ic.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND d.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY), avg_sqft AS (SELECT FLOOR_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_NAME) SELECT i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER, i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_sqft AS a ON i.FLOOR_NAME = a.FLOOR_NAME WHERE i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > a.avg_sqft ORDER BY i.FLOOR_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.ROOM_NUMBER NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count, MIN(min_term_start_date) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') AS overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered, MAX(scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_avg AS da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units, fo.DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM (SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED)) AS ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_stats AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.record_count_variance, (t.max_record_count - t.min_record_count) AS record_count_range FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS max_record_count, MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS t ON i.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY i.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ss2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject, ss2.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') AS ss2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss2.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.PUBLISHER, i.material_count, i.min_used_price, s.avg_new_shelf_price AS benchmark_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.min_used_price < s.avg_new_shelf_price * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_USED_PRICE' WHEN i.min_used_price > s.avg_new_shelf_price * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_USED_PRICE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USED_PRICE' END AS used_price_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) AS s ON i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AND i.PUBLISHER = s.PUBLISHER
