WITH DeptSubjectEnrollment AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), ActiveGradStudentsByDept AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, m.DEPARTMENT FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment, ags.total_active_grad_students FROM DeptSubjectEnrollment AS dse JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudentsByDept AS ags ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ags.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VAR_SAMP(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.avg_area, r.area_variance, r.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM RoomAreaStats AS r JOIN EngineeringCourses AS e ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY r.area_variance DESC NULLS LAST, e.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectStats2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), DeptMaxEnrollmentCurrentTerm AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, d.max_enrollment, d.TERM_START_DATE FROM SubjectStats2014FA AS s JOIN DeptMaxEnrollmentCurrentTerm AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH AreaRooms AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_TYPE, MIN(t1.FLOOR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 400), E_BuildingRooms AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t2.AREA, t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_CODE, t1.DLC_KEY, MIN(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.DLC_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE 'E%' AND t2.AREA > 50), CombinedRooms AS (SELECT ar.BUILDING_ROOM, ar.FLOOR, ar.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ar.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ar.BUILDING_NAME, ar.BUILDING_TYPE, ar.window_column AS area_window_min_floor, NULL AS FCLT_ROOM_KEY, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS DEPT_CODE, NULL AS DLC_KEY, NULL AS dlc_window_min_area, 'AreaRooms' AS Source FROM AreaRooms AS ar UNION ALL SELECT eb.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, eb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS BUILDING_NAME, NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE, NULL AS area_window_min_floor, eb.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, eb.AREA, eb.DEPT_CODE, eb.DLC_KEY, eb.window_column AS dlc_window_min_area, 'E_BuildingRooms' AS Source FROM E_BuildingRooms AS eb) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, area_window_min_floor, FCLT_ROOM_KEY, AREA, DEPT_CODE, DLC_KEY, dlc_window_min_area, Source FROM CombinedRooms ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST
WITH top_subjects AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_dept FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), dept_enroll_stddev AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, des.enrolled_stddev FROM top_subjects AS ts LEFT JOIN dept_enroll_stddev AS des ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.material_count DESC NULLS LAST, des.enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), MathematicsRowNumber AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities, COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Mathematics_Activities, MAX(acdr.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS Mathematics_Activity_Ratio FROM ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS acdr LEFT JOIN MathematicsRowNumber AS mrn ON acdr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mrn.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY Mathematics_Activity_Ratio DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), SubjectSummary AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.window_column FROM DeptCourseStats AS dcs JOIN SubjectSummary AS ss ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ss.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS subject_rank, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS avg_record_count, 'SubjectOffered' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.window_column AS avg_record_count, 'TipDetail' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, Source NULLS FIRST
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), SubjectReserveStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VAR_SAMP(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM TopSubjects AS ts LEFT JOIN SubjectReserveStats AS srs ON ts.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ts.num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH RecordCountVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.record_count_variance, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count FROM RecordCountVariance AS rcv JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount AS gmr ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH LibraryStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), TermSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.TOTAL_UNITS, ts.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev FROM TermSubjects AS ts LEFT JOIN LibraryStats AS ls ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectsIn2025FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), DeptYearSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectsIn2025FA AS s JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH TipDetailWindow AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), TopIAPActivities AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3) SELECT tdw.SUBJECT_ID, tdw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tdw.TERM_START_DATE, tdw.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tdw.window_column, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, tia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM TipDetailWindow AS tdw JOIN TopIAPActivities AS tia ON tdw.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY tdw.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA AS s LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), TopReservedSubjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials FROM TopReservedSubjects AS trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS dense_rank_over_offer_dept_code, s2.window_column AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE NULLS FIRST, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.geometric_mean_total_units, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.subject_count, s.min_total_units FROM GeometricMeanUnits AS g JOIN SubjectStats AS s ON g.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY g.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH avg_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), min_year_total_units AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') SELECT aes.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aes.avg_enrollment, aes.enrollment_variance, mytu.min_academic_year, mytu.total_units_sum FROM avg_enrollment_stats AS aes CROSS JOIN min_year_total_units AS mytu
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS window_column_1, NULL AS window_column_2, 'Enrolled' AS Reason FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS window_column_1, s2.window_column AS window_column_2, 'Units' AS Reason FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column_1, window_column_2, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), UnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedStats AS (SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, NULL AS total_units_variance, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats AS e UNION ALL SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_CODE, u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, u.total_units_variance, 'UnitsVariance' AS Reason FROM UnitsVariance AS u) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, total_units_variance, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH RecordCountVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedStats AS (SELECT r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, r.record_count_variance, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM RecordCountVariance AS r JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount AS g ON r.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
WITH TipMaterials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10), EnrolledSubjects AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, t.total_tip_materials, NULL AS offered_subject_count, NULL AS min_enrolled_students, 'TipMaterials' AS Reason FROM TipMaterials AS t UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS total_tip_materials, e.offered_subject_count, e.min_enrolled_students, 'EnrolledSubjects' AS Reason FROM EnrolledSubjects AS e) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, total_tip_materials, offered_subject_count, min_enrolled_students, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), EECS_Students AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM EECS_Students AS eecs JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dus.avg_total_units > 0 AND NOT dus.stddev_total_units IS NULL ORDER BY eecs.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST, eecs.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), Sub2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS activity_title_row_number, s2.window_column AS academic_year_dense_rank FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.TERM_CODE, subq1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.avg_enrolled_students, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 INNER JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH OrgRoomStats AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC NULLS LAST), ProvostDeptStats AS (SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id, h.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DLC_KEY) SELECT p.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.org_unit_count, p.min_department_id, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_range, o.area_variance, o.area_stddev FROM ProvostDeptStats AS p JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON p.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN OrgRoomStats AS o ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, o.area_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DepartmentEnrollments AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10), DepartmentCourseLibraryStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units FROM DepartmentEnrollments AS de JOIN DepartmentCourseLibraryStats AS dcls ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST
WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), YearlyEnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CAST(STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yes.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN YearlyEnrolledStats AS yes ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yes.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, mc.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6), Subq2 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH EngineeringSubjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS eng_dept_name FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), DeptYearSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.window_column, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units FROM EngineeringSubjects AS es JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats AS dys ON es.eng_dept_name = dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, es.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.subject_code_count, s2.min_dept_budget_code FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectCodes AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), BuildingStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.window_column, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM SubjectCodes AS sc JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats AS bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.min_enrolled_per_dept FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH YearlyRecordStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), HighTotalMaterialYears AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > (SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM (SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS sub)) SELECT y.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.avg_record_count, y.record_count_range, y.record_count_variance, h.total_materials FROM YearlyRecordStats AS y JOIN HighTotalMaterialYears AS h ON y.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY y.record_count_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH AvgStddevUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s2_SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS s2_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH AcademicYearVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicYearVariance AS ayv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.COURSE_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'), DeptCourseLibraryStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA AS s JOIN DeptCourseLibraryStats AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.enrolled_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, s2.enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), DegreeGrantingDeptStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VAR_SAMP(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, dds.avg_course_number_ascii, dds.var_course_number_ascii FROM TopSubjects AS ts JOIN DegreeGrantingDeptStats AS dds ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ts.num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectStats AS dss ON dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_total_units, enrolled_variance FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, t0.TERM_CODE, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM'), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT p.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, p.TERM_DESCRIPTION, p.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.TERM_END_DATE, p.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM PreviousTerms AS p JOIN DeptSubjectStats AS d ON p.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY p.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY NULLS FIRST, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.CALENDAR_DATE, s1.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_window FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE
WITH EngineeringCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DepartmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VAR_SAMP(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column, ds.avg_course_number_ascii, ds.var_course_number_ascii FROM EngineeringCourses AS ec JOIN DepartmentStats AS ds ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), Subq2 AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS LIB_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH AcademicYearUnitsVariance AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), AcademicYearTipRecordVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayuv.total_units_variance, aytrv.record_count_variance FROM AcademicYearUnitsVariance AS ayuv JOIN AcademicYearTipRecordVariance AS aytrv ON ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aytrv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = aytrv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ayuv.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST, aytrv.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH dept_units_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), eng_tip_materials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, etm.total_tip_materials FROM dept_units_stats AS dus JOIN eng_tip_materials AS etm ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats AS des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH HarvardCrossEnrollmentDepts AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON so.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), Subjects2012SU AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_KEY, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s.window_column FROM Subjects2012SU AS s WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM HarvardCrossEnrollmentDepts) ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH MaterialStats AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price, d.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, d.TERM_CODE), DepartmentUnits AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, c.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.PUBLISHER, ms.material_count, ms.min_used_price, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance FROM MaterialStats AS ms JOIN DepartmentUnits AS du ON ms.TERM_CODE = du.TERM_CODE
WITH enrolled_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), units_stats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats AS e LEFT JOIN units_stats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptClusterStats AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE), DeptUnitStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.CLUSTER_TYPE, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_enrolled_students, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance FROM DeptClusterStats AS dcs JOIN DeptUnitStats AS dus ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS gmmps LEFT JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, 'LibrarySubject' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, s2.window_column, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 'IAPActivity' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, Source NULLS FIRST
WITH material_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VAR_SAMP(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), unique_materials_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats AS um LEFT JOIN material_stats AS ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS s1_window_column, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column AS s2_window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST, s2.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH term_2025fa_subjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), engineering_subjects_window AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.window_column FROM term_2025fa_subjects AS t1 JOIN engineering_subjects_window AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), eng_subjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, dv.total_units_variance FROM eng_subjects AS es LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dv.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, es.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dts.avg_enrollment, dts.enrollment_variance, dts.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS dts JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals AS edt ON dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dts.enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), ProvostDepts AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_avg_area, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, NULL AS window_column FROM RoomStats AS r UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, p.DLC_KEY, NULL AS window_avg_area, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column FROM ProvostDepts AS p) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DLC_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name_key FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subquery2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.dept_name_key = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH iap_activities_windowed AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), iap_activities_dense_ranked AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT iaw.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iaw.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iaw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iaw.SUBJECT_TITLE, iaw.window_column AS activity_row_number, iadr.window_column AS activity_dense_rank FROM iap_activities_windowed AS iaw LEFT JOIN iap_activities_dense_ranked AS iadr ON iaw.ACTIVITY_TITLE = iadr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND iaw.TERM_CODE = iadr.TERM_CODE
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, 'SubjectInfo' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, 'TopDeptYear' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
