WITH EmployeeTypeDeptStats AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), SubjectOfferStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.person_count, e.min_mit_id, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column FROM EmployeeTypeDeptStats AS e JOIN SubjectOfferStats AS s ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE NULLS FIRST, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus JOIN EngineeringSubjects AS es ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST, es.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC NULLS LAST), DLCRoomAreaVariation AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FR.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, drv.DLC_NAME, drv.coefficient_of_variation FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats AS srs JOIN DLCRoomAreaVariation AS drv ON srs.DLC_KEY = drv.DLC_KEY ORDER BY srs.stddev_room_sqft DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column AS material_status_row_number, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.window_column AS avg_enrollment_window FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH EngineeringCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DepartmentCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VAR_SAMP(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii FROM EngineeringCourses AS ec JOIN DepartmentCourseStats AS dcs ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ec.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), EnrolledStudentsStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, ess.enrolled_students_variance, ess.enrolled_students_stddev FROM GeometricMeanUnits AS gmu JOIN EnrolledStudentsStats AS ess ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ess.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ess.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), FallSubjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_CODE, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, fs.window_column, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM FallSubjects AS fs JOIN AvgVarUnits AS avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avu.avg_total_units > 12 AND avu.var_total_units >= 10 ORDER BY avu.var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST, fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, fs.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH dept_stats AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST), eng_subjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.total_units_range, dept_stats.total_units_variance FROM eng_subjects LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH dept_subject_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), library_subjects_2014fa AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.window_column FROM dept_subject_stats AS dss JOIN library_subjects_2014fa AS lso ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.join_dept_name AND dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = lso.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats AS ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats AS sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses AS tms JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS lms ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count ORDER BY tms.material_count DESC NULLS LAST, lms.reserve_count DESC NULLS LAST

WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.COURSE_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'), DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA AS so JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON so.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, dus.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST

WITH DeptSchoolRQStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), LibrarySubjects2014FA AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM LibrarySubjects2014FA AS l JOIN DeptSchoolRQStats AS d ON l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = d.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, l.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH EnrollmentStats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MaterialStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, ms.geometric_mean_record_count FROM EnrollmentStats AS es JOIN MaterialStats AS ms ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS section_count, MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 3 GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Sub2 AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS section_count, MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.section_count AS section_count_units_gt_3, s1.min_enrolled AS min_enrolled_units_gt_3, s2.section_count AS section_count_units_gt_6, s2.min_enrolled_students AS min_enrolled_units_gt_6 FROM Sub1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FR.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats AS d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST

WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.join_dept_name = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s1.window_column AS avg_subject_enrollment_number, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS min_num_enrolled_students_window FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH dlc_org_stats AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VAR_SAMP(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), room_area_stats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev FROM room_area_stats AS ras LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats AS dos ON ras.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST
WITH CategoryEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE), SchoolUnitStats AS (SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ces.activity_count, ces.min_fee, sus.SCHOOL_NAME, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_variance, sus.total_units_stddev FROM CategoryEnrollmentStats AS ces JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = (SELECT c2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c2 WHERE c2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) AND ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON d.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN SchoolUnitStats AS sus ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = sus.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ces.activity_count, ces.min_fee, sus.SCHOOL_NAME, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_variance, sus.total_units_stddev ORDER BY ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST, ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE NULLS FIRST, sus.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH MaterialStatusCounts AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), LibraryReserveCounts AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count FROM MaterialStatusCounts AS msc JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN LibraryReserveCounts AS lrc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count ORDER BY msc.material_count DESC NULLS LAST, lrc.reserve_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS des JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals AS edt ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY edt.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DLC_CV AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FR.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), AY_DEPT_SUBJECTS AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_CV AS d JOIN AY_DEPT_SUBJECTS AS a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DLC_KEY NULLS FIRST, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH RecordCountVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.record_count_variance, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountVariance AS rcv JOIN EnrolledStats AS es ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subjects2019FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subjects2009SP AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP') SELECT s19.SUBJECT_ID, s19.SUBJECT_TITLE, s19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s19.window_column AS window_column_2019FA, s09.TOTAL_UNITS, s09.window_column AS window_column_2009SP FROM Subjects2019FA AS s19 JOIN Subjects2009SP AS s09 ON s19.SUBJECT_TITLE = s09.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s09.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s19.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), subq2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT subq1.summary_subject_title, subq1.COURSE_NUMBER, subq1.offered_summary_subject_title, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_total_units, subq2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, subq1.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 'AtLeast5Enrolled' AS Reason FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, s2.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 'Offered2019FA' AS Reason FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12), Sub2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 AND NOT t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NULL) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS row_number_within_subject_title, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_academic_year FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE
WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment AS gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate AS scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH AdvanceSignUpSubjects AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.TERM_CODE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, a.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, a.window_column, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, 'AdvanceSignUp' AS Reason FROM AdvanceSignUpSubjects AS a UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS MAX_ENROLLMENT, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats AS e) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH Subject2010FA AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA'), Subject2025FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT s10.SUBJECT_ID, s10.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2010FA, s10.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s10.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2010FA, s10.window_column, s25.SUBJECT_TITLE, s25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s25.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s25.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2025FA, s25.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2025FA, s25.TERM_START_DATE, s25.TERM_END_DATE, s25.TERM_PARAMETER, s25.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM Subject2010FA AS s10 JOIN Subject2025FA AS s25 ON s10.SUBJECT_ID = s25.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s10.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, s25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH provost_area_dept_orgs AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), facility_org_hr_stats AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(hr_unit_count) - MIN(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_range, VAR_SAMP(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_variance, STDDEV(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT h.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM HR_ORG_UNIT AS h WHERE NOT h.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY) AS hr_stats ON m.DLC_KEY = hr_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, f.org_unit_count_range, f.org_unit_count_variance, f.org_unit_count_stddev FROM provost_area_dept_orgs AS p JOIN facility_org_hr_stats AS f ON p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WITH IAP_Activities_2021JA AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), IAP_Activities_Max30 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a21.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a21.CALENDAR_DATE, a21.window_column AS row_number_window, a30.window_column AS dense_rank_window FROM IAP_Activities_2021JA AS a21 JOIN IAP_Activities_Max30 AS a30 ON a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE = a30.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectOfferings2025FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), ReservedMaterialStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VAR_SAMP(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.TERM_START_DATE, so.TERM_END_DATE, so.TERM_PARAMETER, so.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, rms.reserved_material_range, rms.reserved_material_variance, rms.reserved_material_stddev FROM SubjectOfferings2025FA AS so JOIN ReservedMaterialStats AS rms ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = rms.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, so.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS course_dense_rank, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_dept FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH LibraryReserveU AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), CombinedResults AS (SELECT lru.SUBJECT_ID, lru.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lru.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lru.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lru.TERM_START_DATE, lru.window_column, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.avg_record_count, tms.record_count_variance FROM LibraryReserveU AS lru LEFT JOIN TipMaterialStats AS tms ON lru.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS window_column, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.avg_record_count, tms.record_count_variance FROM TipMaterialStats AS tms WHERE NOT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR IN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM LibraryReserveU)) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, window_column, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_record_count, record_count_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH EnrolledSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subjects2016SP AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, es.TERM_CODE, es.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.avg_enrolled_students, s16.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s16.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s16.window_column FROM EnrolledSubjects AS es JOIN Subjects2016SP AS s16 ON es.SUBJECT_ID = s16.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY es.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, es.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST
WITH avg_var_units AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), top_reserved_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, trs.reserved_materials, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM top_reserved_subjects AS trs LEFT JOIN avg_var_units AS avu ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST, avu.var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DegreeGrantingSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), BuildingSubjectUnits AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT dgs.SUBJECT_CODE, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgs.SCHOOL_NAME, dgs.window_column, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bsu.avg_total_units, bsu.stddev_total_units FROM DegreeGrantingSubjects AS dgs JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON dgs.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingSubjectUnits AS bsu ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY dgs.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, dgs.window_column NULLS FIRST, bsu.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH TopOrganizations AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), MajorOrgSpaceUnits AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2) SELECT torg.ORGANIZATION_NAME, torg.space_unit_count, mspu.num_space_units FROM TopOrganizations AS torg LEFT JOIN MajorOrgSpaceUnits AS mspu ON torg.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mspu.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH DeptYearSubjects AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, s.num_enrolled_variance, s.num_enrolled_stddev FROM DeptYearSubjects AS d JOIN DeptEnrolledStats AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.department) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY department NULLS FIRST, ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH EnrolledStudentsVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MinYearTotalUnits AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') SELECT esv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, esv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, esv.enrolled_students_variance, mytu.min_academic_year, mytu.total_units_sum FROM EnrolledStudentsVariance AS esv CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits AS mytu
WITH eng_dept_2021_summary AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM eng_dept_2021_summary AS e JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH DepartmentCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.window_column FROM DepartmentCourseStats AS dcs JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ses ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s1.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.person_count, s1.min_mit_id, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.EMPLOYEE_TYPE NULLS FIRST, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gm.geometric_mean_enrollment, sc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, sc.subject_count, sc.min_term_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment AS gm JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS sc ON gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, sc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH AvgVarUnitsByDeptYear AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), TopReservedSubjects2009SP AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.reserved_materials, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units FROM TopReservedSubjects2009SP AS t JOIN AvgVarUnitsByDeptYear AS a ON t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST, a.var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectsWithMaterials AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), SubjectsIn2019FA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') SELECT swm.SUBJECT_ID, swm.SUBJECT_TITLE, swm.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, swm.TERM_CODE, swm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, swm.ISBN, swm.window_column AS material_status_row_number, sif.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sif.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sif.window_column AS department_row_number FROM SubjectsWithMaterials AS swm JOIN SubjectsIn2019FA AS sif ON swm.SUBJECT_ID = sif.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY swm.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, swm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST, sif.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s2.unique_materials FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s2.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects AS ts JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department ORDER BY ts.material_count DESC NULLS LAST, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH SubjectStddev AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectWindow AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.SUBJECT_ID, sw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.window_column, ss.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectWindow AS sw JOIN SubjectStddev AS ss ON sw.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM Subquery1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH AvgVarStdPerDept AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), GeomMeanPerDept AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.total_units_variance, a.total_units_stddev, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgVarStdPerDept AS a JOIN GeomMeanPerDept AS g ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), EngineeringDeptEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT dg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dg.SCHOOL_NAME, dg.course_count, dg.min_cip_code, ed.total_enrollment FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS dg JOIN EngineeringDeptEnrollment AS ed ON dg.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ed.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH RecordCountVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CombinedStats AS (SELECT r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, r.record_count_variance, 'RecordCountVariance' AS Reason FROM RecordCountVariance AS r UNION ALL SELECT s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.subject_count, s.min_total_units, NULL AS record_count_variance, 'SubjectStats' AS Reason FROM SubjectStats AS s) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, record_count_variance, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST, DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS sub1_window_column, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column AS sub2_window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE
WITH DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsc.subject_count, dsc.min_isbn, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dev.enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST
