WITH reserve_material_details AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), subject_record_count_variance AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmd.TERM_CODE, rmd.SUBJECT_ID, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmd.ISBN, rmd.SUBJECT_TITLE, rmd.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM reserve_material_details AS rmd LEFT JOIN subject_record_count_variance AS srv ON rmd.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID
WITH SubjectEnrolledStats AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA'), DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ses.avg_enrolled_students, dlu.avg_total_units, dlu.total_units_variance, dlu.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectEnrolledStats AS ses LEFT JOIN DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS dlu ON ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dlu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH DepartmentVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA AS s JOIN DepartmentVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH dept_units_stats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), dept_enrollment AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, de.total_enrolled FROM dept_units_stats AS dus JOIN dept_enrollment AS de ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH record_count_variance_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT v.ACADEMIC_YEAR, v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, v.record_count_variance, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM record_count_variance_per_year AS v JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS g ON v.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY v.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_CODE = s2.SCHOOL_CODE
WITH dept_subject_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), building_units_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM dept_subject_stats AS dss JOIN building_units_stats AS bus ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = bus.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, dss.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, ss.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), Subjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS window_column, 'TopSubjects' AS Reason FROM TopSubjects AS ts UNION ALL SELECT s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS material_count, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column, 'Subjects2014FA' AS Reason FROM Subjects2014FA AS s2014) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH lib_subs AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'), tip_subs AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT lib_subs.SUBJECT_ID, lib_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS LIB_SUBJECT_TITLE, lib_subs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lib_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS LIB_TERM_DESCRIPTION, lib_subs.TERM_START_DATE, lib_subs.TERM_END_DATE, lib_subs.min_enrolled_per_dept, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tip_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS TIP_SUBJECT_TITLE, tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS TIP_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tip_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tip_subs.window_column FROM lib_subs JOIN tip_subs ON lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST
SELECT d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_area, d1.area_range, d1.area_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC NULLS LAST) AS d1 JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) AS d2 ON d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH dept_enrollments AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10), library_subjects AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_enrollments, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.subject_count, l.min_total_units FROM dept_enrollments AS d JOIN library_subjects AS l ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_enrollments DESC NULLS LAST, l.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DeptUnits AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EECSStudents AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_variance FROM EECSStudents AS eecs LEFT JOIN DeptUnits AS du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY eecs.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST, eecs.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), UnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats AS es JOIN UnitsVariance AS uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), IapActivityStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance FROM TipMaterialStats AS tms JOIN IapActivityStats AS ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.activity_count, s1.earliest_start_date, s1.latest_end_date, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY NULLS FIRST, s2.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO') SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, Total_Tip_Details.Total_Tip_Details FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS Total_Tip_Details FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Tip_Details ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Tip_Details.ACADEMIC_YEAR), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.Total_Tip_Details, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_DEPT_RANK, s2.Total_Subjects AS DEPT_TOTAL_SUBJECTS FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.window_column AS subq1_dense_rank, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subq2_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.window_column AS subq2_dense_rank FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON subq1.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN subq2 ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq1.window_column DESC NULLS LAST, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, subq2.window_column NULLS FIRST, subq2.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH category_stats AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME), category_stats_final AS (SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM category_stats AS i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC NULLS LAST), subject_offerings AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT csf.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, csf.avg_max_enrollment, csf.var_max_enrollment, csf.avg_minus_var, so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.TERM_START_DATE, so.TERM_END_DATE, so.TERM_PARAMETER, so.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM category_stats_final AS csf CROSS JOIN subject_offerings AS so ORDER BY csf.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH engineering_dept_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) AS sub) AS a ON i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enrollment), library_reserve_materials AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY FROM WITH academic_year_variation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), dept_reserved_materials_2009sp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > (SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, drm.reserved_materials FROM academic_year_variation AS ayv LEFT JOIN dept_reserved_materials_2009sp AS drm ON ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH SubjectStats AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1), SubjectStatsWithYear AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE FROM SubjectStats AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE), CategoryMaxEnrollment AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), CategoryMaxEnrollmentAgg AS (SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM CategoryMaxEnrollment GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column AS running_sum_total_units_within_school, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.highest_max_enrollment FROM SubjectStatsWithYear AS s JOIN CategoryMaxEnrollmentAgg AS c ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH iap_category_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC NULLS LAST), library_subjects_2019sp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST, OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST, OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT ics.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ics.avg_max_enrollment, ics.var_max_enrollment, ics.avg_minus_var, lso.subject_title, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lso.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM iap_category_stats AS ics LEFT JOIN library_subjects_2019sp AS lso ON ics.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ics.avg_minus_var DESC NULLS LAST, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST

d.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dcr.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC JOIN top_departments AS td ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, td.num_courses DESC NULLS LAST
WITH org_room_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.AREA) AS room_count, AVG(ic.AREA) AS avg_area, MIN(ic.AREA) AS min_area, MAX(ic.AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE UPPER(ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME) LIKE 'R%' GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(ic.AREA) > 300 ORDER BY avg_area DESC NULLS LAST), org_coeff_var AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.room_count, ors.avg_area, ors.min_area, ors.max_area, ocv.coefficient_of_variation FROM org_room_stats AS ors JOIN org_coeff_var AS ocv ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ocv.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ors.avg_area DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > (SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.reserved_materials FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, subq2.reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), filtered_departments AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC), dept_counts AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC) SELECT fd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fd.avg_total_units, fd.stddev_total_units, ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, ic2.isbn_count, ic2.min_faculty_mit_id, dc.total_tip_detail_records FROM filtered_departments AS fd JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON fd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_counts AS dc ON ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dc.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ORDER BY fd.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > (SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST), record_count_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, rcv.record_count_variance, rcv.unique_departments FROM geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS gme JOIN record_count_variance_cte AS rcv ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST, rcv.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) AS hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.school_with_highest_avg, dus.school_avg_total_units, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR, des.subject_count, des.min_total_units, des.benchmark_enrollment, des.enrollment_category FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DepartmentGeometricMean AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N'), dept_year_totals AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, total_enrollment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST) AS dept_rank FROM dept_year_totals), subject_enrollments AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS subj_rank FROM inner_cte2) SELECT dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgm.geometric_mean_total_units, rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rd.total_enrollment, se.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM DepartmentGeometricMean AS dgm JOIN ranked_depts AS rd ON dgm.DEPARTMENT_CODE = rd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN subject_enrollments AS se ON rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = se.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = se.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND se.subj_rank = 1 WHERE rd.dept_rank <= 5 ORDER BY dgm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST, rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, rd.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq2.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS sum_lecture_units_by_grade_type, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_academic_year, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, AVG(inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte2.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte2.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte2.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.window_column, cte2.department_geometric_mean, cte2.department_avg_total_units, cte2.unit_category FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH OrgSpaceUnits AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(space_unit_count) AS highest_space_unit_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME), LargeRooms AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100) SELECT * FROM inner_cte), OrgRoomCombined AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.highest_space_unit_count, r.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, r.ROOM_FULL_NAME, r.AREA, r.BUILDING_TYPE, r.window_column FROM OrgSpaceUnits AS o JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN LargeRooms AS r ON fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME = r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING WHERE BUILDING_NAME_LONG = r.BUILDING_NAME_LONG)) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, highest_space_unit_count, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ROOM_FULL_NAME, AREA, BUILDING_TYPE, window_column FROM OrgRoomCombined ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME NULLS FIRST, BUILDING_NAME_LONG NULLS FIRST, ROOM_FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH dept_units AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC NULLS LAST), dept_materials AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VAR_SAMP(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS s ORDER BY i.material_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.department_geometric_mean, du.department_avg_total_units, du.unit_category, dm.material_count_range, dm.material_count_variance, dm.material_count_stddev, dm.variance_category FROM dept_units AS du JOIN dept_materials AS dm ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY du.department_geometric_mean DESC NULLS LAST, dm.material_count_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(t3.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t3 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU')) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, s1.top_subject_title, s1.top_enrollment, s2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH YearTermStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(at.TERM_CODE) AS term_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(term_count) AS avg_term_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.term_count, b.avg_term_count, CASE WHEN i.term_count > b.avg_term_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' WHEN i.term_count < b.avg_term_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS term_year_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte AS b), TermEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.term_count, yts.avg_term_count, yts.term_year_category, tes.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tes.max_enrollment_range, tes.max_enrollment_variance, tes.max_enrollment_stddev FROM YearTermStats AS yts JOIN TermEnrollmentStats AS tes ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = tes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY yts.term_count DESC NULLS LAST, tes.max_enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH GeometricMeanDepts AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte) AS a ON i.geometric_mean_area > a.avg_geom_mean ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_area DESC NULLS LAST), TopVarianceOrgs AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT r.DEPT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DEPT_CODE, icte.area_variance, icte.area_stddev, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.area_variance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DEPT_CODE, gmd.geometric_mean_area, NULL AS area_variance, NULL AS area_stddev, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, 'HighGeometricMean' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDepts AS gmd UNION ALL SELECT tvo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, tvo.DEPT_CODE, NULL AS geometric_mean_area, tvo.area_variance, tvo.area_stddev, tvo.ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, 'TopVariance' AS Reason FROM TopVarianceOrgs AS tvo) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_CODE, geometric_mean_area, area_variance, area_stddev, ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME NULLS FIRST

NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
