WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.min_record_count, s2.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i1.SUBJECT_ID, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.window_column, i1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i2.TOTAL_UNITS, i2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (i2.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte1 AS i1 JOIN inner_cte2 AS i2 ON i1.SUBJECT_TITLE = i2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_activity AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), dept_enroll_var AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.ACADEMIC_YEAR, da.subject_count, da.avg_subject_count, da.activity_level, dev.SCHOOL_NAME, dev.coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_activity AS da JOIN dept_enroll_var AS dev ON da.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY da.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, da.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH highest_avg_units AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), eng_dept_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) AS sub) AS a ON i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enrollment) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, h.highest_avg_total_units FROM eng_dept_enrollment AS e LEFT JOIN highest_avg_units AS h ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VAR_SAMP(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.AREA AS room_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS f ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, c.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.avg_area, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev, s2.room_area FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptStats2019FA AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects), DegreeEng2021 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.subject_count > 0 THEN CAST(inner_cte.total_enrollment * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(inner_cte.subject_count, 0) ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte) SELECT d21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d21.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d21.subject_count, d21.total_enrollment, d21.avg_enrollment_per_subject, ds19.enrolled_range, ds19.enrolled_variance, ds19.enrolled_stddev, ds19.total_subjects AS total_subjects_2019FA FROM DegreeEng2021 AS d21 LEFT JOIN DeptStats2019FA AS ds19 ON d21.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds19.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d21.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH DeptStddev AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), EngDeptMaterials AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.highest_enrolled_stddev, NULL AS total_tip_materials, NULL AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject, 'HighStddev' AS Reason FROM DeptStddev AS d UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS highest_enrolled_stddev, e.total_tip_materials, e.avg_tip_materials_per_subject, 'EngMaterials' AS Reason FROM EngDeptMaterials AS e ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH Subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE), Subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, ActivityCounts.Total_Activities, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) AS ActivityCounts ON inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ActivityCounts.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.window_column AS DENSE_RANK_WINDOW, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s2.window_column AS ROW_NUMBER_WITHIN_ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.Total_Activities FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.join_dept_name FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') AS overall) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH activity_category_rank AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME), dept_year_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units) SELECT acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE, acr.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, acr.MAX_ENROLLMENT, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, acr.window_column, dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units, dys.avg_enrolled_students FROM activity_category_rank AS acr CROSS JOIN dept_year_enrollment_stats AS dys
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_variance AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ISBN, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.avg_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, dv.variance_category FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.subject_count, ds.total_enrollment, ds.avg_enrollment_per_subject, sm.SUBJECT_TITLE, subject_materials_final AS sm ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_variance AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, dv.avg_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, dv.variance_category FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST, total_library_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ayls.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST, ayls.total_library_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), cte1 AS (SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_units_window FROM inner_cte1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.TERM_CODE), cte2 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.max_units_window, cte2.max_avg_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cte2.max_avg_total_units > 9 ORDER BY cte2.max_avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_NAME) AS max_assignable_area, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ASSIGNABLE_AREA NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ASSIGNABLE_AREA > (SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST)) SELECT s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.FISCAL_PERIOD, s1.max_assignable_area, s1.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME = s2.BUILDING_NAME AND s1.FISCAL_PERIOD = s2.FISCAL_PERIOD AND s1.window_column = s2.window_column ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.FISCAL_PERIOD NULLS FIRST

ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, s2.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t3.TERM_CODE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, dept_counts.total_subjects_per_dept, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, WITH IAP_Activities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, Activity_Count.Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Activity_Count ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Activity_Count.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TIP_MaterialVariance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.Total_Activities, tmv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tmv.max_record_count_variance, tmv.min_record_count_variance FROM IAP_Activities AS ia JOIN TIP_MaterialVariance AS tmv ON ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tmv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.department_name, s1.total_library_subjects_offered, s2.highest_avg_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST, s1.enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST, s1.total_library_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, s2.highest_avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH iap_activities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT BETWEEN 15 AND 30 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), year_enrollment_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap_activities.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, iap_activities.TERM_START_DATE, iap_activities.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iap_activities.window_column, year_enrollment_stats.enrolled_range, year_enrollment_stats.enrolled_variance, year_enrollment_stats.variability_category FROM iap_activities JOIN year_enrollment_stats ON iap_activities.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = year_enrollment_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.unique_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT AVG(unique_subject_count) AS avg_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_cte ON inner_cte1.unique_subject_count > avg_cte.avg_unique_subjects), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 JOIN (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.window_column, cte2.avg_enrolled_students, cte2.enrollment_category, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.unique_subject_count FROM cte2 JOIN cte1 ON cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST

window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM') AS overall) SELECT subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULLS FIRST, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST

COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME), TermJoin AS (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST, ass.SPONSOR_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.min_fee, s.SPONSOR_TYPE FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), dept_2022fa_stats AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, d22.max_lecture_units, d22.TERM_START_DATE, d22.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_2022fa_stats AS d22 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptVariance AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.enrolled_students_variance, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptVariance AS dv JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte.subject_count, cte.min_total_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) AND cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ORDER BY cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_course_subjects AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER), engineering_tip_materials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units, etm.total_tip_materials FROM dept_course_subjects AS dcs JOIN engineering_tip_materials AS etm ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_tip_materials AS (SELECT AVG(total_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) AS x) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials, CASE WHEN i.total_tip_materials > a.avg_tip_materials * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_RESOURCE' WHEN i.total_tip_materials < a.avg_tip_materials * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_RESOURCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS resource_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_tip_materials AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_start_date, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' JOIN (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS s2 ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_CODE, td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.num_subjects, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5) AS td JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') AS s ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.COURSE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ccso.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), EngineeringCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_subject_title, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, e.course_number, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.course_subject_title, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS course_offer_dept_name, e.window_column AS course_row_number, s_dept.SCHOOL_NAME AS department_school_name FROM SubjectStats AS s JOIN EngineeringCourses AS e ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s_dept ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s_dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, e.course_number NULLS FIRST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), dept_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.summary_subject_title, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.offered_summary_subject_title, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.stddev_total_units, dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentUnits AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), EECSStudents AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dc.num_courses FROM EECSStudents AS eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits AS du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT) AS dc ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY eecs.window_column NULLS FIRST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), DeptYearSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.GRADE_TYPE, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VAR_SAMP(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptAvgUnits AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (e.TOTAL_UNITS - dau.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN EngDegreeCourses AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptAvgUnits AS dau ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), UnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance, es.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM EnrolledStats AS es JOIN UnitsVariance AS uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND NOT uv.total_units_variance IS NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), AcademicYearDesc AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), DeptCounts AS (SELECT at.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptRanked AS (SELECT dc.TERM_CODE, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.dept_subject_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.TERM_CODE ORDER BY dc.dept_subject_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS dept_rank FROM DeptCounts AS dc) SELECT ict.TERM_CODE, ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ict.subject_count, ict.total_enrollment, ayd.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_prominent_department, dr.dept_subject_count AS department_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ict JOIN AcademicYearDesc AS ayd ON ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayd.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN DeptRanked AS dr ON ict.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE AND dr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ict.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_subject_counts AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID, s2025fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
