WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year_stats AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST), regular_term_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mry.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, mry.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, mry.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, mry.num_subjects AS most_recent_year_num_subjects, rts.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, rts.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, rts.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance, rts.num_subjects AS regular_term_num_subjects FROM most_recent_year_stats AS mry JOIN regular_term_stats AS rts ON mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rts.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, most_recent_year_avg_total_units, most_recent_year_total_units_range, most_recent_year_total_units_variance, most_recent_year_num_subjects, regular_term_avg_total_units, regular_term_total_units_range, regular_term_total_units_variance, regular_term_num_subjects FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(most_recent_year_avg_total_units), MAX(most_recent_year_total_units_range), VAR_SAMP(most_recent_year_total_units_variance), SUM(most_recent_year_num_subjects), AVG(regular_term_avg_total_units), MAX(regular_term_total_units_range), VAR_SAMP(regular_term_total_units_variance), SUM(regular_term_num_subjects) FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS d UNION ALL SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ic.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d2 WHERE d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) AS avg_max_enrollment_in_category FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL) ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgVarTotalUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AvgVarTotalUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST, g.geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COALESCE(s.subjects_with_required_materials, 0) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND t.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS s ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, mat_count.num_materials, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0d ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t0d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t0 ON t2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS mat_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mat_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = mat_count.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.avg_enrollment = m.max_avg_enrollment), MinYearTotalUnits AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_enrollment, t.min_academic_year, t.total_units_sum FROM MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS m CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits AS t ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), DeptMaxEnrolledSubject AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, dms.SUBJECT_ID AS max_enrolled_subject_id, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, dms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledSubject AS dms ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dms.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats AS des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ic.avg_total_units > 3 ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH enrolled_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), units_stats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats AS e LEFT JOIN units_stats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, enrolled_stddev, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units, lss.unique_faculty_count FROM inner_cte AS de JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS unique_faculty_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS so ON l.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) AS lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, lss.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), TopReservedSubjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials, soss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TopReservedSubjects AS trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS soss ON trs.SUBJECT_TITLE = soss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = soss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), YearlyVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CAST(STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0), MaxEnrolledSubject AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation, mes.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, mes.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN YearlyVariation AS yv ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN MaxEnrolledSubject AS mes ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mes.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mes.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC NULLS LAST), DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_codes > (SELECT AVG(avg_subject_codes) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FR.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats AS d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, s.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST, ccso.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') AS s ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dts.avg_enrollment, dts.enrollment_variance, dts.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS dts JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals AS edt ON dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dts.enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.total_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment_in_subject FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.total_enrollment ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN ss.TOTAL_UNITS > dau.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ss.TOTAL_UNITS < dau.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' JOIN dept_avg_units AS dau ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC NULLS LAST, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST

COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST), DeptCounts AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptRanked AS (SELECT d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.ISBN IS NULL AND NOT lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), dept_counts AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, dept_counts.num_subjects FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_area, d1.area_range, d1.area_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC NULLS LAST) AS d1 JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) AS d2 ON d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_area > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM_DEPT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_total_units < inner_cte.avg_area * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_UNIT_DEPT' ELSE 'BALANCED' END AS department_classification FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'), person_role_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities_led FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON AS p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.window_column, p.PERSON_ROLE, p.avg_max_enrollment, p.max_enrollment_range, p.max_enrollment_variance, p.total_activities_led FROM inner_cte AS s CROSS JOIN person_role_enrollment_stats AS p
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentEnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2019FA FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_with_lib_reserve FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, des.num_subjects_2019FA, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.num_subjects_with_lib_reserve FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats AS des JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST, dus.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS d JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev, total_enrollment FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, SUM(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte) AS t ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END NULLS FIRST, DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10) AS de JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) AS lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollments, ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollments, ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FR.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats AS d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectUnitsStddev AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC NULLS LAST), Subjects2012SU AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s1.total_units_stddev FROM Subjects2012SU AS s2 JOIN SubjectUnitsStddev AS s1 ON s2.SUBJECT_TITLE = s1.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev, max_enroll.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS max_enroll ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = max_enroll.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanRecordCount AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CoefficientOfVariation AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM GeometricMeanRecordCount AS gmr JOIN CoefficientOfVariation AS cov ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectDenseRank AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), SubjectUnitSum AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, sus.SUBJECT_ID, sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM SubjectDenseRank AS sdr JOIN SubjectUnitSum AS sus ON sdr.SUBJECT_ID = sus.SUBJECT_ID), DeptAvgEnrolled AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.subject_dense_rank, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.running_sum_total_units, dae.avg_enrolled AS avg_enrolled_per_subject_in_dept FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DeptAvgEnrolled AS dae ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), avg_enrollment_per_year AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR), min_year_total_units AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mytu.min_academic_year, mytu.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment_per_year AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR CROSS JOIN min_year_total_units AS mytu WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS des JOIN (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) AS es ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS ata ON es.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, es.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.subject_count, s.min_term_start_date, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_enrollment FROM SubjectCategoryStats AS s JOIN GeometricMeanEnrollment AS g ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, COALESCE(tip_stats.total_tip_materials, 0) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS tip_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, tms.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tms.SUBJECT_ID, tms.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities AS ia JOIN TipMaterialStats AS tms ON ia.TERM_CODE = tms.TERM_CODE), avg_across_terms AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(window_column) AS avg_record_count_across_terms FROM (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') AS sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, icte.PREREQUISITES, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TERM_END_DATE, icte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, (icte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT - aat.avg_record_count_across_terms) AS deviation_from_academic_year_avg FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN avg_across_terms AS aat ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aat.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsc.subject_count, dsc.min_isbn, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance AS dev ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dev.enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_isbn, icte.enrolled_variance, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_isbn, icte.enrolled_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS instructor_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.ISBN IS NULL AND NOT lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, subq2.instructor_count FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS gmmps JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST, astu.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, avg_design.avg_design_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.DESIGN_UNITS) AS avg_design_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS avg_design ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_design.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_design.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST, icte.stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degree_granting_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT WHERE UPPER(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'E%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) BETWEEN 5 AND 15) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_courses, ic.degree_granting_courses FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.degree_granting_courses >= 0.6 * ic.total_courses
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Highest_Enrolled_Subject, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Highest_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA')) AS tso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats AS ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats AS sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE AREA > 40)
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.subject_dense_rank, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.running_sum_total_units, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS dense_rank_material_status, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON icte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lrm.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC NULLS LAST), DLCRoomAreaVariation AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FR.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, drv.DLC_NAME, drv.coefficient_of_variation, drv.DLC_KEY FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats AS srs JOIN DLCRoomAreaVariation AS drv ON srs.DLC_KEY = drv.DLC_KEY ORDER BY srs.stddev_room_sqft DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_room_sqft, icte.stddev_room_sqft, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK ON icte.DLC_KEY = FODK.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_room_sqft, icte.stddev_room_sqft, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY icte.stddev_room_sqft DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats AS des JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals AS edt ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME), AvgTotalEnrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_total_enrollment FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) AS x) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, i.total_enrollment, (i.total_enrollment - a.avg_total_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgTotalEnrollment AS a ORDER BY i.total_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS LIB_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgStddevUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
