WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), subject_enrollment AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE), instructor_counts AS (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS INSTRUCTOR_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY), ranked_instructors AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM instructor_counts AS ic) SELECT se.SUBJECT_ID, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.TOTAL_ENROLLED, ri.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS MOST_FREQUENT_INSTRUCTOR, ri.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT AS INSTRUCTOR_OCCURRENCES FROM subject_enrollment AS se LEFT JOIN ranked_instructors AS ri ON se.SUBJECT_ID = ri.SUBJECT_ID AND ri.rn = 1 ORDER BY se.TOTAL_ENROLLED DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA'), DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), SubjectLibraryReserveCount AS (SELECT lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS num_library_reserves FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm GROUP BY lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.avg_enrolled_students, dlu.avg_total_units, dlu.total_units_variance, dlu.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(slrc.num_library_reserves, 0) AS num_library_reserves FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS dlu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dlu.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' LEFT JOIN SubjectLibraryReserveCount AS slrc ON tso.TERM_CODE = slrc.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = slrc.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), SubjectOfferedWithYear AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column AS subject_rank, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS avg_record_count, 'SubjectOffered' AS Source FROM SubjectOfferedWithYear AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.window_column AS avg_record_count, 'TipDetail' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, Source NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, tso.TERM_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, ms.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS total_unique_responsible_faculty FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS ms ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.CALENDAR_DATE, s1.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_window, s1.TERM_CODE FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.CALENDAR_DATE, i.row_number_window, i.dense_rank_window, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS grad_student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.grad_student_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Frequent_Subject, so.subject_offer_count, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_offer_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS so JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(subject_offer_count) AS max_count FROM (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_offer_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS sub GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS maxsub ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = maxsub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND so.subject_offer_count = maxsub.max_count ORDER BY ic.grad_student_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgStddevUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.geometric_mean_total_units, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t WHERE t.rn = 1) AS dept_stats ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TipMaterialsByDepartment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10), OfferedSubjectsStats AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT tmbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, oss.SCHOOL_NAME, tmbd.total_tip_materials, oss.offered_subject_count, oss.min_enrolled_students FROM TipMaterialsByDepartment AS tmbd JOIN OfferedSubjectsStats AS oss ON tmbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = oss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.total_tip_materials, icte.offered_subject_count, icte.min_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_tip_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS subject_max_total_units FROM (SELECT icte.*, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) AS ic JOIN (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED)) AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.max_total_units = s.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DegreeGrantingSubjectCounts AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), EngineeringDeptTotals AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), EngineeringSubjectCounts AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, dsc.num_unique_subjects, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN DegreeGrantingSubjectCounts AS dsc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment, esc.num_unique_subjects, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM EngineeringDeptTotals AS e LEFT JOIN EngineeringSubjectCounts AS esc ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, Reason NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.DLC_KEY, su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NULL), org_counts AS (SELECT ic.space_unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, ic.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.DLC_NAME), org_rank AS (SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS space_unit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.space_unit_name ORDER BY COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) DESC NULLS LAST) AS org_rank FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE NOT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT oc.space_unit_name, oc.org_count AS total_organization_count, oc.DLC_NAME, orr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS most_represented_organization, orr.space_unit_count AS space_unit_count_for_organization FROM org_counts AS oc LEFT JOIN org_rank AS orr ON oc.space_unit_name = orr.space_unit_name AND orr.org_rank = 1 ORDER BY oc.org_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.window_column, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) AS es ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON es.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST, es.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s2.unique_materials FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST) AS s1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) AS s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s2.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.unique_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.unique_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), YearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_start_date, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM YearDeptSubjectStats AS yds JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_start_date, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH material_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VAR_SAMP(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), unique_materials_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats AS um LEFT JOIN material_stats AS ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev, MIN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH units_variance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), subject_counts AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, u.total_units_variance, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.subject_count, s.min_start_date, s.total_enrolled_students FROM units_variance AS u JOIN subject_counts AS s ON u.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY u.total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST, s.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH eng_dept_2021_summary AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, (CAST(e.total_enrollment AS REAL) / NULLIF(NULLIF(e.subject_count, 0), 0)) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM eng_dept_2021_summary AS e JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, enrolled_students_variance, enrolled_students_stddev, avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment_per_subject > (SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment_per_subject) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), dept_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.summary_subject_title, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.offered_summary_subject_title, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.stddev_total_units, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), ActivityEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST), ActivityAcademicYears AS (SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS unique_academic_years FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.material_count, aes.enrollment_range, aes.enrollment_variance, aes.enrollment_stddev, aay.unique_academic_years FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN ActivityEnrollmentStats AS aes ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aes.ACTIVITY_TITLE LEFT JOIN ActivityAcademicYears AS aay ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aay.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptCourseSubjects AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER), EngineeringDeptTips AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptCourseSubjects AS d JOIN EngineeringDeptTips AS e ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), SubjectWindowStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column, sws.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS dcs JOIN SubjectWindowStats AS sws ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcs.course_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), library_units_stats AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, library_units_stats.min_academic_year, library_units_stats.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN library_units_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = library_units_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = library_units_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), dept_unit_benchmark AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN dept_unit_benchmark AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS dense_rank_within_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, LENGTH(d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION) AS activity_description_length FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), math_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.dense_rank_within_category, i.row_number_within_enrollment_type, i.activity_description_length, m.row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN math_cte AS m ON i.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND i.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgStddevUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanUnits AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits AS a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits AS g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, EXP(AVG(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 THEN LN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) END)) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON t.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS course_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.course_dense_rank, tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS subject_rank_within_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), GeomMeanMaterials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN GeomMeanMaterials AS g ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON c2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') ORDER BY i.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(FR.AREA) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats AS d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VAR_SAMP(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST), EOMaterialDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO'), EOCounts AS (SELECT eomd.TERM_PARAMETER, COUNT(*) AS eo_material_count FROM EOMaterialDetails AS eomd GROUP BY eomd.TERM_PARAMETER) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.avg_materials_per_subject, icte.variance_materials_per_subject, icte.stddev_materials_per_subject, eomd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eomd.TERM_CODE, eomd.SUBJECT_ID, eomd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN EOMaterialDetails AS eomd ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eomd.TERM_PARAMETER JOIN EOCounts AS eoc ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eoc.TERM_PARAMETER WHERE eoc.eo_material_count > 5 ORDER BY icte.variance_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, eomd.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomAreaStats AS (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats AS ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats AS sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC NULLS LAST), OverallAvgArea AS (SELECT AVG(r.AREA) AS overall_avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r WHERE r.AREA > 40) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_area, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN i.avg_area > o.overall_avg_area * 1.1 THEN 'LARGE_AREA' WHEN i.avg_area < o.overall_avg_area * 0.9 THEN 'SMALL_AREA' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS area_size_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN OverallAvgArea AS o ORDER BY i.area_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TipMaterialStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), IapActivityStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), IapActivityMax AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance, iam.highest_max_enrollment FROM TipMaterialStats AS tms JOIN IapActivityStats AS ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN IapActivityMax AS iam ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = iam.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = iam.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2022FA FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST, num_subjects_2022FA DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'), subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.CALENDAR_DATE, s1.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_window, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t3 ON s1.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d1.enrolled_stddev, d2.offered_subject_count, d2.min_enrolled_students FROM DeptEnrolledStats AS d1 JOIN DeptSubjectCounts AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, inner_cte.offered_subject_count, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students, COALESCE(ts.total_subjects_2019FA, 0) AS total_subjects_2019FA FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_subjects_2019FA FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS ts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sponsor_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST), subject_running_sum AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT ses.SPONSOR_NAME, ses.avg_max_enrollment, ses.var_max_enrollment, srs.SUBJECT_ID, srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, srs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srs.window_column, srs.SUBJECT_TITLE, srs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM sponsor_enrollment_stats AS ses CROSS JOIN subject_running_sum AS srs) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, avg_max_enrollment, var_max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column, SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA')

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA'), DepartmentStudentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dss.COURSE_LEVEL, dss.student_count, dss.min_cip_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentStudentStats AS dss ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, dss.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, dept_course_counts.course_count AS total_12unit_courses, dept_subject_counts.top_subject_title, dept_subject_counts.subject_course_count FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS course_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_course_counts JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, subject_course_count FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS dept_subject_counts ON dept_course_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte) AS ic ON dept_course_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dept_course_counts.course_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
