WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS engineering_running_sum_units FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptTotals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.dept_row_number, i.engineering_running_sum_units, NULL AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS dept_row_number, NULL AS engineering_running_sum_units, d.total_enrolled_students FROM DeptTotals AS d ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH employee_type_department_g AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_subjects_regular_terms AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y') SELECT etd.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, etd.person_count, etd.min_mit_id, msrt.SUBJECT_TITLE, msrt.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msrt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, msrt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msrt.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, msrt.max_total_units, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM employee_type_department_g AS etd JOIN math_subjects_regular_terms AS msrt ON etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msrt.join_dept_name) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), SubjectReserveStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VAR_SAMP(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC NULLS LAST), InstructorCounts AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS num_unique_instructors FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_reserve_materials, ic.num_unique_instructors, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectReserveStats AS srs ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN InstructorCounts AS ic ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ic.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.TERM_CODE = ic.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), LibSubjStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits AS a JOIN LibSubjStats AS l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o ORDER BY i.var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), SubjectRecordCountVariance AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.window_column, srv.record_count_variance, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectRecordCountVariance AS srv ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY NULLS FIRST, ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringTipMaterials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, etm.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials AS etm ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ic.avg_total_units >= 6 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH material_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VAR_SAMP(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), unique_materials_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats AS um LEFT JOIN material_stats AS ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev, COALESCE(SUM(lrmd_count.total_reserved_n), 0) AS total_reserved_n FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_reserved_n FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON at.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'N' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS lrmd_count ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = lrmd_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VAR_SAMP(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.avg_materials_per_subject, icte.variance_materials_per_subject, icte.stddev_materials_per_subject, t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_INDICATOR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t0 ON t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND icte.TERM_PARAMETER = t2.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY icte.variance_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN DeptCourseStats AS dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = dcs.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.subject_code_count, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = sos.COURSE_NUMBER AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.subject_code_count, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EngSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.window_column, ses.SUBJECT_ID, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ses.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ses.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ses.max_enrolled_students FROM EngSubjects AS es JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ses ON es.SUBJECT_TITLE = ses.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.max_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.max_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, sq2.subject_code_count, sq2.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN Subquery2 AS sq2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_CODE = sq2.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VAR_SAMP(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_area DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Frequent_Subject, ms.Subject_Offered_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Offered_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS ms ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_area DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringTipMaterials AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_tip_materials_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_tip_materials) AS avg_total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.total_tip_materials, (i.total_tip_materials - a.avg_total_tip_materials) AS deviation_from_avg_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_tip_materials_cte AS a ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), DepartmentMaxEnrollment AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dme.max_enrollment, dme.TERM_START_DATE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DepartmentMaxEnrollment AS dme ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AcademicYearVariance AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ayv.record_count_variance FROM DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss JOIN AcademicYearVariance AS ayv ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.record_count_variance, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON t.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VAR_SAMP(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC NULLS LAST), DeptMaterialStats AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VAR_SAMP(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev, AVG(material_count) AS avg_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN (SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY material_count_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev, dms.avg_materials_per_subject FROM DeptCourseStats AS dcs JOIN DeptMaterialStats AS dms ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_materials_per_subject) AS overall_avg_materials FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, i.avg_materials_per_subject, o.overall_avg_materials, CASE WHEN i.avg_materials_per_subject > o.overall_avg_materials * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIALS' WHEN i.avg_materials_per_subject < o.overall_avg_materials * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MATERIALS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS materials_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_with_rq_material FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), subq2 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.enrolled_variance FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.enrolled_variance, tc.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS tc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, icte.enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH YearlyTipStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), YearlyTotalMaterials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > (SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM (SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS sub)) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.avg_record_count, yts.record_count_range, yts.record_count_variance, ytm.total_materials FROM YearlyTipStats AS yts JOIN YearlyTotalMaterials AS ytm ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ytm.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_record_count, inner_cte.record_count_range, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.total_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_record_count, inner_cte.record_count_range, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.total_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.total_materials DESC NULLS LAST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID, s2025fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIMIT 5) AS dsc JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') AS s2025fa ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), DeptEnrolledStudents AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), CombinedDeptInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo), EngineeringEnrolled AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS engineering_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) AS engineering_enrolled FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN EngineeringEnrolled AS e ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) > 0.6 * i.total_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST

= ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, bsc.SUBJECT_CODE AS Most_Frequent_Subject_Code, bsc.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, cso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS bsc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bsc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bsc.rnk = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, MAX(d.DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE) AS max_dept_last_activity_date FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dss.max_dept_last_activity_date FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_CODE = dss.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, scd.COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COURSE_LEVEL, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS EMAIL_ADDRESS, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY department_name NULLS FIRST, COURSE_LEVEL NULLS FIRST, FULL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgRoomStats AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VAR_SAMP(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC NULLS LAST), ProvostDeptStats AS (SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id, h.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DLC_KEY) SELECT p.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.org_unit_count, p.min_department_id, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_range, o.area_variance, o.area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM ProvostDeptStats AS p JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON p.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN OrgRoomStats AS o ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.org_unit_count, i.min_department_id, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.area_stddev, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND NOT r.AREA IS NULL GROUP BY i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.org_unit_count, i.min_department_id, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.area_stddev ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.area_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), GeometricMeanMaterials AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT COALESCE(i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count, s.unique_subjects FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN GeometricMeanMaterials AS g ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SubjectCounts AS s ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count, SUM(s.unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects FROM GeometricMeanMaterials AS g JOIN SubjectCounts AS s ON g.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), dept_units_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_enrollment AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME), subject_max_enrollment AS (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST, t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, de.total_enrolled_students, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, sme.SUBJECT_ID AS max_enrolled_subject_id, sme.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, sme.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_subject_num_students FROM dept_enrollment AS de JOIN dept_units_stats AS dus ON de.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN subject_max_enrollment AS sme ON de.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sme.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sme.rn = 1 ORDER BY de.total_enrolled_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, rmd.TERM_CODE, rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rmd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmd.window_column AS reserve_window_avg_record_count, tmd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS textbook_material_key, tmd.SUBJECT_ID, tmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS textbook_academic_year, tmd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS textbook_term_description, tmd.window_column AS textbook_row_number, tmd.TERM_START_DATE AS textbook_term_start_date, tmd.TERM_END_DATE AS textbook_term_end_date FROM inner_cte AS rmd JOIN (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') AS tmd ON rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AND rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC NULLS LAST, tmd.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DLC_KEY, t1.DLC_NAME, t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY), OrgCounts AS (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE NOT ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS unique_space_unit_count, MAX(oc.org_count) AS highest_org_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN OrgCounts AS oc ON icte.DLC_KEY = oc.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptRoomStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VAR_SAMP(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev FROM EngDegreeCourses AS e LEFT JOIN DeptRoomStats AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.window_column, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, COALESCE(r.room_count, 0) AS room_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS r ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), MathematicsRowNumber AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities, COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Mathematics_Activities, MAX(acdr.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, ROUND(CAST(CAST(COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS Mathematics_Activity_Ratio FROM ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS acdr LEFT JOIN MathematicsRowNumber AS mrn ON acdr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mrn.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio, ROUND(CAST(AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS Avg_Max_Enrollment FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio ORDER BY inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS material_status_row_number FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), dept_info AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), school_counts AS (SELECT di.SCHOOL_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT di.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM dept_info AS di GROUP BY di.SCHOOL_CODE), school_ranked AS (SELECT sc.SCHOOL_CODE, sc.Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.Subject_Count DESC NULLS LAST) AS school_rank FROM school_counts AS sc) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.material_status_row_number, di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sr.SCHOOL_CODE AS Most_Represented_School, sr.Subject_Count AS Subjects_From_School FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_info AS di ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = di.SUBJECT_ID JOIN school_ranked AS sr ON di.SCHOOL_CODE = sr.SCHOOL_CODE AND sr.school_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), DepartmentUnitStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitStats AS dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at WHERE at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), DeptEnrolledStudents AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), CombinedDeptInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_total_enrolled FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > a.avg_total_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < a.avg_total_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subject_code_ranks AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), building_units_stats AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT scr.SUBJECT_CODE, scr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM subject_code_ranks AS scr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN building_units_stats AS bus ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) FROM (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_avg)
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY NULLS FIRST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, COALESCE(tip_counts.total_tip_materials, 0) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS tip_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), DeptCourseLibraryStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units, dcls.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DeptCourseLibraryStats AS dcls ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST), Subjects2017JA AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA AS s LEFT JOIN DeptVariation AS dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, i.coefficient_of_variation, dept_count.total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_count ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300), RoomDeptHierarchy AS (SELECT icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS mdh ON fo.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME), RankedDept AS (SELECT rdh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rdh.DLC_NAME, rdh.Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rdh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY rdh.Room_Count DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM RoomDeptHierarchy AS rdh), BuildingStats AS (SELECT icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(icte.AREA) AS Total_Area, COUNT(*) AS Num_Rooms FROM inner_cte AS icte GROUP BY icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, bs.Total_Area, bs.Num_Rooms, rd.DLC_NAME AS Most_Represented_Dept_Hierarchy, rd.Room_Count AS Dept_Room_Count FROM BuildingStats AS bs LEFT JOIN RankedDept AS rd ON bs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = rd.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AND rd.rn = 1 ORDER BY bs.Total_Area DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), dept_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN dept_stats AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, i.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST), department_count_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_department_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, geometric_mean_record_count_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, department_count_cte.unique_department_count FROM inner_cte JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN department_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
