WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AvgVarUnits AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), FallSubjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_CODE, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, fs.window_column, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM FallSubjects AS fs JOIN AvgVarUnits AS avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avu.avg_total_units > 12 AND avu.var_total_units >= 10), SubjectCounts AS (SELECT fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM (SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') AS fs JOIN (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 12 AND VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) >= 10) AS avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION), RollupResults AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectCounts AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION UNION ALL SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, sc.total_subjects FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte) AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectCounts AS sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rr.window_column, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.avg_total_units, rr.var_total_units, rr.total_subjects FROM RollupResults AS rr ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, rr.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), SubjectSummary AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, ss.window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectSummary AS ss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ss.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ss.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Sub2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s1.join_dept_name FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_avg AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, icte.max_enrollment, icte.TERM_START_DATE, davg.dept_avg_units AS department_avg_units, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > davg.dept_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < davg.dept_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_classification FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_avg AS davg ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = davg.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), subject_record_count_variance AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, VAR_SAMP(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY l.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN subject_record_count_variance AS srv ON i.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RecordCountStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EnrolledStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcs.record_count_variance, rcs.record_count_stddev, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountStats AS rcs JOIN EnrolledStats AS es ON rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcs.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, subj_stats.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS subj_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subj_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = subj_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') AS s JOIN (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_rank_in_dept, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.dense_rank_material_status, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dlc_org_stats AS (SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VAR_SAMP(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fdlk JOIN (SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) AS org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC NULLS LAST), room_area_stats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, ras.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM room_area_stats AS ras LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats AS dos ON ras.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_column, icte.org_count_range, icte.org_count_variance, icte.org_count_stddev, org_room_counts.total_rooms_per_org FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms_per_org FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_room_counts ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = org_room_counts.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subq2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_rank, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS material_status_rank FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank FROM CombinedSubjects) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'MEDIUM_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST, COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS subject_window_column, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_12units, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS course_window_column, s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.subject_title_2019fa, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_window_column, inner_cte.course_number, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_title_12units, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.course_window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TipRQDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities AS ia JOIN TipRQDetails AS trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DepartmentUnits AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST), EECSStudents AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_student_counts.student_count FROM EECSStudents AS eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits AS du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS dept_student_counts ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_student_counts.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY eecs.window_column NULLS FIRST) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT) SELECT sq2.SUBJECT_KEY, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.offering_count, sq2.total_units, sq1.window_column, sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM Subquery2 AS sq2 JOIN Subquery1 AS sq1 ON sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sq1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT), unit_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.offering_count, ic.total_units, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN ic.total_units > ub.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.total_units < ub.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN unit_benchmark AS ub ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, stats.avg_course_number_ascii, stats.var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VAR_SAMP(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS stats ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS gmmps LEFT JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, avg_lecture_units.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS avg_lecture_units ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_lecture_units.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MinYearTotalUnitsUG AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.HGN_CODE = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, mytu.min_academic_year, mytu.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnitsUG AS mytu
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST), EngineeringSubjectsWithFaculty AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, esf.SUBJECT_ID, esf.SUBJECT_TITLE, esf.window_column, esf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS dus JOIN EngineeringSubjectsWithFaculty AS esf ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST, esf.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), SubjectReserveStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VAR_SAMP(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC NULLS LAST), SubjectInstructorStats AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS num_unique_instructors FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_reserve_materials, sis.num_unique_instructors, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SubjectReserveStats AS srs ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN SubjectInstructorStats AS sis ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = sis.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.num_reserve_materials DESC NULLS LAST, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), AcademicYearTipStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CurrentTermDepartmentStats AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS dept_total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ict.TERM_CODE, ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ict.subject_count, ict.total_enrollment, ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayts.avg_record_count, ayts.record_count_range, ayts.record_count_variance, ctds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ctds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ctds.dept_subject_count, ctds.dept_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ict JOIN AcademicYearTipStats AS ayts ON ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN CurrentTermDepartmentStats AS ctds ON ict.TERM_CODE = ctds.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ict.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST, ctds.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' GROUP BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_NAME ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), OrgRanks AS (SELECT icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.space_unit_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DLC_NAME ORDER BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS org_rank FROM inner_cte AS icte), HRDeptStats AS (SELECT fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) DESC NULLS LAST) AS dept_rank FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_NAME, o.space_unit_count, o.org_rank, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Frequent_HR_Department, h.hr_org_unit_count FROM OrgRanks AS o LEFT JOIN HRDeptStats AS h ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = h.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND h.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY o.space_unit_count DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_enrolled_stddev FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ss.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND ss.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ict.SUBJECT_TITLE, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ict.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, ses.avg_enrolled_students, ses.subject_enrolled_variance, ses.subject_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ict JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ses ON ict.SUBJECT_TITLE = ses.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ses.avg_enrolled_students > 5 ORDER BY ict.material_count DESC NULLS LAST, des.num_enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST

sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.avg_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, sos.SUBJECT_ID AS top_subject_id, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') AS sos ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AND sos.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), SubjectReservedMaterialStats AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VAR_SAMP(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN (SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TERM_END_DATE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, srms.reserved_material_range, srms.reserved_material_variance, srms.reserved_material_stddev, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectReservedMaterialStats AS srms ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srms.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA') ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EngDeptSubjects AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), ActiveGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, a.total_active_grad_students FROM EngDeptSubjects AS e JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudents AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, total_active_grad_students, CASE WHEN subject_count > 0 THEN CAST(total_enrollment AS REAL) / NULLIF(subject_count, 0) ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS running_sum_total_units, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s2.CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, s2.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), AcademicYearTipStats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayts.avg_record_count, ayts.record_count_range, ayts.record_count_variance, dept_stats.unique_departments FROM inner_cte AS cts JOIN AcademicYearTipStats AS ayts ON cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN (SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE) AS dept_stats ON cts.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cts.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, MAX(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS max_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER), EOMaterialDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO') SELECT ict.TERM_PARAMETER, ict.max_materials_per_subject, eomd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eomd.TERM_CODE, eomd.SUBJECT_ID, eomd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ict JOIN EOMaterialDetails AS eomd ON ict.TERM_PARAMETER = eomd.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY ict.max_materials_per_subject DESC NULLS LAST, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST, eomd.window_column NULLS FIRST
WITH EngineeringSubjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS eng_dept_name, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), DeptYearSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CombinedResults AS (SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.window_column, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM EngineeringSubjects AS es JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats AS dys ON es.eng_dept_name = dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT cr.SUBJECT_TITLE, cr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.TOTAL_UNITS, cr.window_column, cr.subject_count, cr.min_total_units FROM CombinedResults AS cr UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS window_column, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units FROM DeptYearSubjectStats AS dys ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RegularTermStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON c.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, i.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, i.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, r.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, r.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, r.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN RegularTermStats AS r ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.avg_total_units > 6 AND r.total_units_variance < 20 ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST, r.total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_subject_title, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS course_offer_dept_name, s2.window_column AS course_row_number FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.avg_enrolled_window, i.course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.course_subject_title, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.course_offer_dept_name, i.course_row_number, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > i.avg_enrolled_window * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < i.avg_enrolled_window * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST, i.course_number NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST), engineering_subjects_window AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_avg_enrollment AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.window_column, (t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - t3.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS t1 JOIN engineering_subjects_window AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN dept_avg_enrollment AS t3 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST), MostPopularSubject AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, mps.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Represented_Subject, mps.total_enrolled AS Students_In_Most_Represented_Subject FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS dev ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostPopularSubject AS mps ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mps.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mps.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mps.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC NULLS LAST, dev.enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptRoomStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VAR_SAMP(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC NULLS LAST), EngDegreeCourses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM DeptRoomStats AS d JOIN EngDegreeCourses AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(f.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS f WHERE f.AREA > 40) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST, COURSE_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST), geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC NULLS LAST), department_count_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, geometric_mean_record_count_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, department_count_cte.department_count FROM inner_cte JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN department_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.min_enrolled_window, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.running_sum_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.GRADE_TYPE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, icte.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST), UnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.DEPARTMENT_CODE, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats AS es JOIN UnitsVariance AS uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND NOT uv.total_units_variance IS NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(*) AS spring_subjects_with_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS ss ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' AND c.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND ss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
WITH dept_terms AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'), subjects_per_term AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VAR_SAMP(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term AS spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2014%' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = 'Cline, Francesca' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT f.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
WITH math_units_per_year AS (SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_units) AS mean_units, STDDEV(total_units) AS stddev_units FROM math_units_per_year) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.total_units FROM math_units_per_year AS m CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE m.total_units > s.mean_units + s.stddev_units ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5

SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(dept_subject_count) - MIN(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VAR_SAMP(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(dept_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN (SELECT s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s WHERE NOT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS stats ON d.SCHOOL_CODE = stats.SCHOOL_CODE AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count_range DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC NULLS LAST, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE NULLS FIRST
