SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VAR_SAMP(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH stats AS (SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS mean_area, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST), res_buildings AS (SELECT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, rb.total_assignable_area FROM res_buildings AS rb CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE rb.total_assignable_area > s.mean_area + s.stddev_area
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_non_grad_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.HGN_CODE_DESC = 'Not for graduate credit' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE LIKE '%JA' AND i.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NULLS FIRST, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH schools_with_ps AS (SELECT DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), subject_units AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_ps) AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND NOT cso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, CAST(STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subject_units GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
SELECT su.SPACE_USAGE, VAR_SAMP(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS variance_square_footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 AND su.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%' GROUP BY su.SPACE_USAGE
SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, VAR_SAMP(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS var_assignable_area, STDDEV(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM (SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND NOT BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' UNION ALL SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR, ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST WHERE NUM_OF_ROOMS > 10 AND NOT BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED') AS all_buildings GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE, CAMPUS_SECTOR
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL
SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS var_subject_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT MIN(fr.AREA) AS min_room_area, SUM(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS total_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT'
SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST
SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY NULLS FIRST, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY NULLS FIRST, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD NULLS FIRST
SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_2014_chemistry_subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2014%' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT COUNT(*) AS swe_harvard_chemistry_subjects_2012 FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subject_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
SELECT at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap ON at.TERM_CODE = iap.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND (iap.IS_CANCELLED IS NULL OR iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') GROUP BY at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY at.TERM_DESCRIPTION NULLS FIRST
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(course_student_count) - MIN(course_student_count) AS student_count_range, VAR_SAMP(course_student_count) AS student_count_variance, STDDEV(course_student_count) AS student_count_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN (SELECT scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS course_student_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY scd2.COURSE, scd2.DEPARTMENT) AS course_stats ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_stats.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE = course_stats.COURSE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count_range DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME NULLS FIRST) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY td.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS min_enrolled_students_window FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON ss.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5
SELECT b.BUILDING_TYPE, EXP(AVG(LN(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA))) AS geometric_mean_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS b JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS f ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_TYPE ORDER BY geometric_mean_assignable_area DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VAR_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS number_of_rooms, SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10
WITH student_counts AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
WITH tip_counts AS (SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID), per_year_stats AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) - MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VAR_SAMP(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts AS tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
WITH building_room_areas AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), stats AS (SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_room_areas) SELECT bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bra.total_room_area FROM building_room_areas AS bra JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY CROSS JOIN stats WHERE bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND bra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area

WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(sc.num_students) - MIN(sc.num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VAR_SAMP(sc.num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_students_per_year, range_students_per_year, var_students_per_year FROM dept_stats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME NULLS FIRST
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, VAR_SAMP(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) AS subject_code_count_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE WHERE NOT SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND NOT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1 ORDER BY fb.BUILDING_NAME NULLS FIRST
SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MAJOR_ORG NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')
SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, STDDEV(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS stddev_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 5
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VAR_SAMP(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, STDDEV(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_counts JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0
SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS min_student_year FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10
SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3
SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER NULLS FIRST, c.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, COUNT(c.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS total_degree_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_library_subjects, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_tip_enrollment FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2020FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 5
SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_range DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE NULLS FIRST, c.TERM_CODE NULLS FIRST
SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY NULLS FIRST) AS room_rank_in_building FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.AREA > 500 AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND (fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IS NULL OR fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') ORDER BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY NULLS FIRST, room_rank_in_building NULLS FIRST
SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE NULLS FIRST, lso.SUBJECT_ID NULLS FIRST

SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID INNER JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ON EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID = MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VAR_SAMP(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VAR_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '17' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE s.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VAR_SAMP(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NULL AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VAR_SAMP(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR NULLS FIRST
SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS NULLS FIRST) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_subjects_with_required_materials FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON sos.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL
